2884636.quote: In the case of any continued or knowing violation of the provisions of section 24-559, 24-560 or 24-572 or any order or rule issued by the environmental control board within the office of administrative trials and hearings or the commissioner pursuant to such provisions or section 24-581 in furtherance of such provisions or where the board finds that the violation of any of such provisions or conditions presents or may present a danger to the environment or threatens to interfere with the operation of the sewer system, the board, after notice and the opportunity for a hearing in accordance with the rules of such board within such office, may issue a cease and desist order requiring any person who owns, leases, operates, controls or supervises any building, structure, facility or installation to cease and desist from any activity or process which causes or is conducted so as to cause such violation within the time specified in such order.

2884636.actor_raw: The environmental control board within the office of administrative trials and hearings
2884636.agency_full: Office of Administrative Trials and Hearings
2884636.action_summary: Establish a schedule of civil penalties indicating minimum and maximum penalties for stormwater violations, or use a schedule adopted by the department.
2884636.quote: The environmental control board within the office of administrative trials and hearings, in its discretion, may, within the limits set forth in this section, establish a schedule of civil penalties indicating the minimum and maximum penalty for each separate offense or may use a schedule adopted by the department.

2884636.actor_raw: Officers and employees of the department and of other city agencies designated by the commissioner
2884636.action_summary: Issue summonses, appearance tickets, orders and notices of violation based upon violations of stormwater management provisions or departmental rules.
2884636.quote: Officers and employees of the department and of other city agencies designated by the commissioner shall have the power to issue summonses, appearance tickets, orders and notices of violation based upon violations of this chapter or rules of the department promulgated hereunder.

2884636.action_summary: Delegate to authorized inspection agents authority to conduct inspections, issue orders requiring stormwater management practices, issue notices of violation for civil penalties, and oversee such agents in accordance with department rules.
2884636.quote: The commissioner shall have the authority to delegate to authorized inspection agents the authority to: (1) Carry out inspections pursuant to this chapter or any rule promulgated pursuant thereto; (2) Issue orders pursuant to section 24-581, or issue orders pursuant to subdivision a of section 24-524 when deemed necessary and appropriate in the course of implementing duties delegated to such authorized inspection agent pursuant to this chapter; (3) Issue notices of violation for civil penalties pursuant to section 24-585, or notices of violation pursuant to subdivision f of section 24-524 when the basis for such notice of violation is observed in the course of implementing duties delegated to such authorized inspection agent pursuant to this chapter.

2884636.actor_raw: An authorized representative of the department of environmental protection
2884636.action_summary: Enter on property and conduct inspections for compliance with stormwater management provisions and departmental rules.
2884636.quote: An authorized representative of the department may enter on any property, consistent with applicable law and in accordance with rules of the department related to such entry and inspection, to inspect for compliance with this chapter and rules of the department promulgated hereunder.

2884636.action_summary: Enter on property and inspect premises or facilities to determine whether they generate significant contributions of pollutants of concern to impaired waters.
2884636.quote: The department shall have the authority to enter and inspect any premises or facility, including, but not limited to, its equipment, practices, operations and records, consistent with applicable law and in accordance with rules of the department related to such entry and inspection. Such entry and inspection shall be conducted during normal operating hours for purposes of determining whether such premises or facility generates significant contributions of pollutants of concern to an impaired water.

2884636.actor_raw: the department of environmental protection or any other agency
2884636.action_summary: Take all actions necessary for timely implementation of this local law, including the promulgation of rules.
2884636.quote: Effective immediately, the department of environmental protection or any other agency may take such actions as are necessary for the timely implementation of this local law, including the promulgation of rules.

2813508.action_summary: Develop educational materials regarding college savings plans, including information on college savings programs, tuition at CUNY and SUNY institutions, financial aid eligibility, and other resources for post-secondary education planning.
2813508.quote: The department shall develop educational materials regarding college savings plans. At a minimum, such materials shall include the following:

2813508.action_summary: Produce and distribute college savings plan materials to each school for distribution to every student upon entry into pre-kindergarten, kindergarten, grade six, and grade nine, and to every new student, in English and additional languages as determined by the department.
2813508.quote: Such materials shall be produced and distributed by the department to each school for distribution to every student of such school upon his or her entry into pre-kindergarten, kindergarten, grade six and grade nine

2813508.action_summary: Ensure that materials developed pursuant to section 3-209.2(b) are provided to all schools in sufficient quantity to satisfy distribution requirements.
2813508.quote: The department shall ensure that materials developed pursuant to subdivision b of this section are provided to all schools in sufficient quantity to satisfy the requirements of subdivisions c and e of this section.

2813508.action_summary: Ensure that college savings plan materials are available in the main or central office in each school and on the department's website for students and parents.
2813508.quote: The department shall ensure that such written materials are available in the main or central office in each school and that such materials are available on the department's website for students and parents who wish to obtain such materials.

2813508.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
2813508.action_summary: Provide college savings plan materials described in section 3-209.2(b) to parents or guardians of newborns within three months after receipt of the report of birth.
2813508.quote: Within three months after the receipt of the report of any birth, the department shall provide college savings plan materials described in subdivision b of section 3-209.2 to the parents or guardian of the child
2813508.deadline_text: Within three months after the receipt of the report of any birth

2813508.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
2813508.action_summary: Make college savings plan materials available on the department's website in English and each of the designated citywide languages.
2813508.quote: The department shall make such college savings plan materials available on its website in English and each of the designated citywide languages as defined in section 23-1101 of the administrative code.

2855583.action_summary: Engage in outreach and education efforts regarding the opportunity to submit works of art for consideration for inclusion in capital projects, including information sessions in each borough and development of written materials describing the submission and selection process.
2855583.quote: The department of cultural affairs shall engage in outreach and education efforts regarding the opportunity to submit works of art for consideration for inclusion in capital projects as provided for by this section. Such outreach and education efforts shall include but not be limited to information sessions in each borough that shall be open to the public and the development of written materials

2855583.action_summary: Make written materials describing the submission and selection process for works of art available in English and in the six languages most commonly spoken by limited English proficient individuals in the city.
2855583.quote: Such written materials shall be made available in English and in the six languages most commonly spoken by limited English proficient individuals in the city as determined by the department of city planning.

2855583.action_summary: Determine the six languages most commonly spoken by limited English proficient individuals in the city.
2855583.quote: Such written materials shall be made available in English and in the six languages most commonly spoken by limited English proficient individuals in the city as determined by the department of city planning.

2855583.action_summary: Post reasonable advance notification of the intention to include works of art in a project on the department website.
2855583.quote: Reasonable advance notification of the intention to include works of art in a project shall also be posted on the website of the department of cultural affairs.

2855583.action_summary: Hold or present at a public meeting, such as a meeting of the community board of the community district in which the project is located, on works of art prior to their inclusion in any project.
2855583.quote: the department of cultural affairs shall hold or present at a public meeting, such as a meeting of the community board of the community district in which the project is located, on such works of art prior to such inclusion.

2855583.action_summary: Post a notice of any public meeting on works of art on the department website not less than fourteen days prior to any such meeting.
2855583.quote: A notice of such public meeting shall be posted on the website of the department of cultural affairs not less than fourteen days prior to any such meeting.
2855583.deadline_text: not less than fourteen days prior to any such meeting

2253271.action_summary: Post on its website reasonable advance notification of the intention to include works of art in a project.
2253271.quote: Reasonable advance notification of the intention to include works of art in a project shall also be posted on the website of the department of cultural affairs.

2253271.action_summary: Hold or present at a public meeting on works of art prior to their inclusion in a project.
2253271.quote: the department of cultural affairs shall hold or present at a public meeting, such as a meeting of the community board of the community district in which the project is located, on such works of art prior to such inclusion.

2253271.action_summary: Post notice of public meetings on works of art on its website not less than fourteen days prior to any such meeting.
2253271.quote: A notice of such public meeting shall be posted on the website of the department of cultural affairs not less than fourteen days prior to any such meeting.
2253271.deadline_text: not less than fourteen days prior to any such meeting

2900915.action_summary: Notify by electronic mail owners of real property who have registered an electronic mail address to receive department of finance property information updates when property tax bills are available online.
2900915.quote: When property tax bills for the quarterly or semi-annual installments of tax due in accordance with this section are available online, the commissioner shall notify by electronic mail owners of real property who have registered an electronic mail address online with the commissioner to receive department of finance property information updates that such bills are available online.

2900915.actor_raw: the commissioner of finance or his or her designee
2900915.action_summary: Include contact information for the office of financial empowerment at the department of consumer affairs in the notice of residential property tax exemptions provided no later than October 31 each year.
2900915.quote: The notice that is required, pursuant to this section, to be provided by the commissioner of finance or his or her designee no later than October thirty-first of each year shall include contact information for the office of financial empowerment at the department of consumer affairs.
2900915.deadline_text: no later than October thirty-first of each year
affected_groups: property owners with residential property tax exemptions

2900915.action_summary: File a list of tax liens that may be included in a sale with the office of the city register and the office of the county clerk of Richmond county not less than ninety days prior to the date of sale.
2900915.quote: The commissioner of finance shall file such list in the office of the city register and the office of the county clerk of Richmond county not less than ninety days prior to the date of sale.
2900915.deadline_text: not less than ninety days prior to the date of sale

2900915.action_summary: Post online the borough, block and lot of property on which a lien has been or will be noticed for sale that was in receipt of specified real property tax exemptions in one or more of the five fiscal years preceding the date of the sale, and post online the borough, block and lot of vacant land classified as class one or class four on which a lien has been or will be noticed for sale.
2900915.quote: Not less than ninety days preceding the date of the sale, the commissioner of finance shall post online, to the extent such information is available, the borough, block and lot of any property on which a lien has been or will be noticed for sale in accordance with paragraph one of this subdivision and that, in one or more of the five fiscal years preceding the date of the sale, was in receipt of a real property tax exemption pursuant to section four hundred twenty-a, four hundred twenty-b, four hundred forty-six or four hundred sixty-two of the real property tax law and, in addition, shall post online, to the extent such information is available, the borough, block and lot of any vacant land classified as class one or class four pursuant to section eighteen hundred two of the real property tax law on which a lien has been or will be noticed for sale in accordance with paragraph one of this subdivision.
2900915.deadline_text: Not less than ninety days preceding the date of the sale

2900915.action_summary: Contact by telephone or electronic mail any person who has registered their telephone number or electronic mail address and has received the ninety-day notice of tax lien sale to inform them of the intention to sell a tax lien.
2900915.quote: The department of finance and the department of environmental protection shall, to the extent practicable, contact by telephone or electronic mail any person who (i) has registered their telephone number or electronic mail address with such departments and (ii) has received the ninety-day notice described in paragraph one of this subdivision.
2900915.deadline_text: within a time period reasonably proximate to the mailing of such notice

2900915.action_summary: Contact by telephone or electronic mail any person who has registered their telephone number or electronic mail address and has received the ninety-day notice of tax lien sale to inform them of the intention to sell a tax lien.
2900915.quote: The department of finance and the department of environmental protection shall, to the extent practicable, contact by telephone or electronic mail any person who (i) has registered their telephone number or electronic mail address with such departments and (ii) has received the ninety-day notice described in paragraph one of this subdivision.
2900915.deadline_text: within a time period reasonably proximate to the mailing of such notice

2900915.action_summary: Promptly provide written notification to the owner of property that a noticed tax lien will not be or was not included in a sale and the reason therefor.
2900915.quote: Where a tax lien on property in the city has been noticed for sale pursuant to subdivision b of this section and such lien, prior to the date of sale, has been paid or is otherwise determined by the commissioner not to be eligible to be sold, the commissioner shall promptly provide written notification to the owner of such property that such lien will not be or was not included in such sale and the reason therefor.

2900915.action_summary: Designate an employee of the department to respond to inquiries from owners of property for which a tax lien has been sold or noticed for sale, and designate an employee to respond to inquiries from owners sixty-five years of age or older.
2900915.quote: The commissioner of finance shall designate an employee of the department to respond to inquiries from owners of property for which a tax lien has been sold or noticed for sale pursuant to subdivision a of this section and shall designate an employee of the department to respond to inquiries from owners sixty-five years of age or older of property for which a tax lien has been sold or noticed for sale pursuant to subdivision a of this section.

2900915.action_summary: Designate at least one employee of the department to respond to inquiries from owners of property for which a tax lien containing a water rents, sewer rents or sewer surcharges component has been sold or noticed for sale.
2900915.quote: The commissioner of environmental protection shall designate at least one employee of the department of environmental protection to respond to inquiries from owners of property for which a tax lien containing a water rents, sewer rents or sewer surcharges component has been sold or noticed for sale pursuant to subdivision a of this section.

2900915.action_summary: Post online the telephone numbers and electronic mail addresses of employees designated to respond to inquiries from property owners regarding tax lien sales, and include them on all publications and notices required by subdivisions a and b of section 11-320.
2900915.quote: The telephone numbers and electronic mail addresses of employees designated pursuant to this subdivision shall be posted online and shall be included on all publications and notices required by subdivisions a and b of this section.

2900915.action_summary: Submit to the council no later than ninety days after the tax lien sale a report on the number of outreach sessions performed in each council district, including specified metrics disaggregated by council district.
2900915.quote: No later than ninety days after the tax lien sale, the commissioner of finance shall submit to the council a report on the number of outreach sessions performed in each council district during the ninety-day period preceding the tax lien sale. Such report shall include: (i) the number of installment agreements begun by property owners or, as defined in subdivision b of section 11-322 of this chapter, other eligible persons, acting on behalf of property owners at each outreach session; (ii) the number of property tax exemption applications begun at each outreach session; (iii) the total number of attendees at each outreach session; (iv) the number of outreach sessions at which a financial counselor was available; (v) the number of property owners, or other eligible persons acting on behalf of property owners, who consulted a financial counselor at each outreach session at which a financial counselor was available; and (vi) the results of such surveys.
2900915.deadline_text: No later than ninety days after the tax lien sale

2900915.action_summary: Post online the information reported to the council pursuant to subdivisions h and i of section 11-320, without specifically identifying any property or property owner except by zip code and randomly generated identifier.
2900915.quote: The commissioner of finance shall post online the information reported to the council pursuant to subdivisions h and i of this section, provided that no information shall be posted online that specifically identifies any property or property owner, except by zip code and a randomly generated identifier.

2900915.actor_raw: the commissioners of finance and environmental protection
2900915.action_summary: Promulgate rules governing installment agreements, including the terms and conditions, payment schedules, and definition and consequences of default.
2900915.quote: No later than September first, two thousand eleven, the commissioners of finance and environmental protection shall promulgate rules governing installment agreements, including but not limited to, the terms and conditions of such agreements, the payment schedules, and the definition and consequences of default;
2900915.deadline_text: No later than September first, two thousand eleven

2900915.actor_raw: the commissioners of finance and environmental protection
2900915.action_summary: Promulgate rules governing eligibility of owners or other eligible persons acting on behalf of owners to enter into installment agreements.
2900915.quote: no later than June first, two thousand fourteen, the commissioners of finance and environmental protection shall promulgate rules governing eligibility of owners or other eligible persons acting on behalf of owners to enter into installment agreements.
2900915.deadline_text: no later than June first, two thousand fourteen

2900915.action_summary: Mail a letter to a property owner or other eligible person after the first missed payment on an installment agreement, stating that the owner or eligible person is at risk of being in default, if payment has not been received within two weeks of the due date.
2900915.quote: If a property owner, or other eligible person acting on behalf of an owner, who has entered into an installment agreement with the department of finance, fails to make a payment pursuant to such agreement, then the department of finance shall, after the first missed payment, mail a letter to the property owner, or other eligible person acting on behalf of an owner, stating that such owner, or other eligible person, is at risk of being in default of such agreement. The letter shall be mailed after the first missed payment if the department has not received payment within two weeks of the due date.

2900915.action_summary: Submit an annual report to the council concerning the sale or sales of tax liens during the preceding year, including specified information about properties, proceeds, purchasers, servicers, redemption rates, and delinquency rates.
2900915.quote: The commissioner of finance shall submit an annual report to the council concerning the sale or sales of tax liens during the preceding year pursuant to this chapter. Such report shall include the following information regarding such sale or sales: a list of properties for which a tax lien or tax liens has or have been sold, including identification of the particular tax lien or tax liens sold; the proceeds received from the sale or sales of tax liens; identification of the purchaser of and servicer for the tax lien or tax liens sold; a report of servicer activities during the immediately preceding year; the redemption rate for tax liens that have been sold; the delinquency rate for real property taxes for the immediately preceding year; and any other information pertinent to the sale of tax liens that may be requested by the council and which is not made confidential pursuant to section 11-208.1 of the code.

2900915.action_summary: Provide to the council a report no later than August 31, 2020 listing all properties on which liens have been sold during the period from January 1, 2015 through December 31, 2019, indicating whether a transfer of or mortgage has been recorded on such properties after the sale of the tax lien.
2900915.quote: In addition to such report, no later than August thirty-first, two thousand twenty, the commissioner shall provide to the council a report listing all properties on which liens have been sold during the period from January first, two thousand fifteen through December thirty-first, two thousand nineteen. The report shall indicate, based on records in the office of the register, whether a transfer of or mortgage recorded on any of such properties has occurred during such period after the sale of any tax lien sold during such period.
2900915.deadline_text: no later than August thirty-first, two thousand twenty

2900915.action_summary: At the request of a council member, conduct outreach sessions in the council member's district addressing actions property owners can take if a lien is sold, types of tax liens subject to sale, installment agreement information, credits and exemptions, and customer surveys; make a good faith effort to have a financial counselor available; and submit a report to the council no later than ninety days after the tax lien sale.
2900915.quote: At the request of a council member, the commissioner of finance, in consultation with the commissioner of housing preservation and development and the commissioner of environmental protection, may conduct outreach sessions in the district of such council member. The scope of such outreach sessions shall include, but need not be limited to, (i) actions property owners can take if a lien is sold on such property; (ii) the type of tax lien or tax liens that can be sold in a tax lien sale; (iii) installment agreement information, including informing attendees in such outreach sessions of their option to enter into an installment agreement for exclusion from the tax lien sale with no down payment, and their option to enter such agreement for a term not more than ten years; (iv) credits and property tax exemptions that may exclude a property from a tax lien sale; (v) distribution of a customer survey to property owners who have received notice of the intention to sell a tax lien on their property, in order to determine the circumstances that led to the creation of the lien; and [(v)] (vi) any other credit or residential real property tax exemption information, which, in the discretion of the commissioner, should be included in such outreach sessions.

3332170.action_summary: Determine waiver applications under section 28-313.3.1 and render written determinations setting forth findings and conclusions for each requirement sought to be waived.
3332170.quote: The commissioner shall determine, under all of the circumstances presented by such application, which of such requirements may appropriately be waived. The commissioner shall render such determination in a writing, which shall set forth in detail the commissioner's findings and conclusions with respect to each requirement sought to be waived.

3332170.action_summary: File written waiver determinations with the department and make them available for public inspection.
3332170.quote: Such written determination shall be filed with the department and shall be available for public inspection.

3332170.actor_raw: the mayor's office for people with disabilities, or its successor agency
3332170.agency_full: Mayor's Office for People with Disabilities
3332170.action_summary: Consult with and advise the commissioner of buildings concerning each application for a waiver under section 28-313.3.1.
3332170.quote: The mayor's office for people with disabilities, or its successor agency shall be consulted by and shall advise the commissioner concerning each application for a waiver under section 28-313.3.1.

3332170.action_summary: Promulgate rules implementing this local law.
3332170.quote: the commissioner of buildings may take all actions necessary for its implementation, including the promulgation of rules

1636850.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
1636850.action_summary: Prepare and distribute a written statement of employee rights and employer obligations under city, state and federal law to licensed employment agencies engaged in job placement of domestic or household employees.
1636850.citation: NYC Admin. Code § 20-771(a), as amended by Section 3
1636850.quote: Such statement of rights and obligations shall be prepared and distributed by the commissioner to licensed employment agencies over which the commissioner has jurisdiction.

1636850.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
1636850.action_summary: Receive and investigate complaints alleging violations of earned sick time requirements, maintain complainant confidentiality, notify complainants of investigation status, and issue notices of violation when appropriate.
1636850.citation: NYC Admin. Code § 20-924(b)–(c), as amended by Section 9
1636850.quote: Upon receiving a complaint alleging a violation of this chapter, the department shall investigate such complaint and attempt to resolve it through mediation. Within thirty days of written notification of a complaint by the department, the person or entity identified in the complaint shall provide the department with a written response and such other information as the department may request. The department shall keep complainants reasonably notified regarding the status of their complaint and any resultant investigation.
1636850.deadline_text: Within thirty days of written notification of a complaint by the department

1636850.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
1636850.action_summary: Prescribe the form and wording of notices of violation for earned sick time violations.
1636850.citation: NYC Admin. Code § 20-924(c), as amended by Section 9
1636850.quote: The commissioner shall prescribe the form and wording of such notices of violation.

1636850.actor_raw: the department, as defined in subdivision s of section 20-912 of the administrative code of the city of New York
1636850.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
1636850.action_summary: Take necessary measures for implementation of earned sick time requirements, including the promulgation of rules, prior to the effective date of this local law.
1636850.quote: the department, as defined in subdivision s of section 20-912 of the administrative code of the city of New York, as added by section five of this local law, shall take such measures as are necessary for the implementation of chapter 8 of title 20 of the administrative code of the city of New York, as added by local law 46 for the year 2013, and as amended by local law number 6 for the year 2014, and as further amended by this local law, including the promulgation of rules.

1636850.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
1636850.action_summary: Exercise all powers relating to receipt, investigation, and resolution of complaints regarding earned sick time, and conduct investigations regarding violations upon the commissioner's own initiative.
1636850.citation: NYC Charter § 2203(e), as amended by Section 1
1636850.quote: The commissioner shall have all powers as set forth in chapter 8 of title 20 of the administrative code relating to the receipt, investigation, and resolution of complaints thereunder regarding earned sick time, and the power to conduct investigations regarding violations of such chapter upon his or her own initiative.

2119770.action_summary: Make electronic mail addresses of veterans' advisory board members available to the public on the office's website.
2119770.quote: The office of veterans' affairs shall make such electronic mail address available to the public on the website of the office of veterans' affairs no later than thirty days after the commencement of the member's term of appointment.
2119770.deadline_text: no later than thirty days after the commencement of the member's term of appointment

5871100.action_summary: Establish a program of photo noise violation monitoring devices to monitor compliance with motor vehicle sound limits.
5871100.quote: The department, in consultation with the police department and the department of transportation, shall establish a program of photo noise violation monitoring devices to monitor compliance with the limitations on sound set forth in section 24-236.
affected_groups: residents exposed to motor vehicle noise

5871100.action_summary: Ensure each photo noise violation monitoring device undergoes an annual calibration check and maintain certification of such calibration.
5871100.quote: Each photo noise violation monitoring device shall undergo an annual calibration check by the manufacturer of such device or by the department. Such manufacturer or the department shall provide a certification of such calibration. The department shall maintain each such certificate of calibration for each photo noise violation monitoring device in operation until the final resolution of all cases involving a notice of violation issued during such year that utilized photographs, microphotographs, videotape, or other recorded images produced by such device.

5871100.action_summary: Utilize necessary technologies to ensure that photographs and recorded images produced by photo noise violation monitoring devices do not identify drivers, passengers, or vehicle contents to the extent practicable.
5871100.quote: The department shall utilize necessary technologies to ensure, to the extent practicable, that photographs, microphotographs, videotape, or other recorded images produced by the photo noise violation monitoring devices do not include images that identify the driver, the passengers, or the contents of the motor vehicle

5871100.action_summary: Select locations for photo noise violation monitoring devices based on motor vehicle noise complaint data and requests, and ensure at least 5 devices in each borough by September 30, 2025.
5871100.quote: To the extent practicable, the department shall select the locations for each photo noise violation monitoring device based on motor vehicle noise complaint data reported by the 311 customer service center and shall consider requests for placement of such devices made by persons including but not limited to, the mayor, comptroller, public advocate, borough presidents, council members, and community boards. Subject to appropriations, the department shall ensure that there are no less than 5 photo noise monitoring devices in each borough by and after September 30, 2025.

5871100.action_summary: Assess requests for installation of photo noise violation monitoring devices and respond within 30 days with a determination of appropriateness.
5871100.quote: Upon receipt of a request by the mayor, comptroller, public advocate, a borough president, a council member, or a community board for installation of a photo noise violation monitoring device at a particular location, the department shall assess the request and respond within 30 days with a determination as to whether the location requested is appropriate for inclusion in the program.

5871100.action_summary: Submit an annual report to the mayor and speaker of the council, and post on the department's website, detailing photo noise violation monitoring device program usage, violations recorded, notices issued, adjudication results, and expenses.
5871100.quote: No later than January 31, 2025, and on January 31 thereafter in each succeeding year in which the program is in operation, the commissioner shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council, and post on the department's website, a report on the use of photo noise violation monitoring devices for the previous calendar year.
5871100.deadline_text: No later than January 31, 2025, and on January 31 thereafter in each succeeding year in which the program is in operation

3541105.actor_raw: the commissioner of the department of parks and recreation
3541105.action_summary: Promulgate rules identifying at least six parks in each borough to be considered public places for AED purposes, and determine the quantity and location of automated external defibrillators to be placed in such parks.
3541105.quote: The commissioner of the department of parks and recreation shall promulgate rules identifying at least six parks in each borough under the jurisdiction of the department of parks and recreation to be considered a public place for the purposes of this section, which would not otherwise be considered such a place, and determining the quantity and location of automated external defibrillators to be placed in such parks

3541105.actor_raw: the department of parks and recreation
3541105.action_summary: Ensure that at least one employee trained in the operation of an automated external defibrillator is present at all pool facilities under the department's jurisdiction during all hours of required supervision.
3541105.quote: At least one employee who is trained in the operation of an automated external defibrillator shall be present at the facilities of any pool under the jurisdiction of the department of parks and recreation during all hours of required supervision.

3541105.actor_raw: the commissioner of the department of parks and recreation
3541105.action_summary: Take such measures as are necessary for the implementation of this local law, including the promulgation of rules, before the effective date of January 1, 2020.
3541105.quote: the commissioner of the department of parks and recreation shall take such measures as are necessary for the implementation of this local law, including the promulgation of rules, before such date.

5555429.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
5555429.action_summary: Assist the Department of Parks and Recreation in removing tree limbs, branches, and vegetation fallen from trees under Parks and Recreation's jurisdiction that obstruct streets after severe weather.
5555429.quote: The department shall assist the department of parks and recreation in removing tree limbs, branches, and vegetation fallen from trees under the jurisdiction of the department of parks and recreation that obstruct streets after severe weather.
5555429.deadline_text: within 10 days of the department receiving such notice, except that such removals need not take place within 10 days if a state of emergency has been declared by the mayor, the governor of the state of New York, or by the president of the United States

5958278.action_summary: Establish an office of healthcare accountability, either as a standalone office or within any office of the mayor or within any department.
5958278.quote: The mayor shall establish an office of healthcare accountability. Such office may be established as a standalone office or within any office of the mayor or within any department.

5958278.actor_raw: the mayor or, if the office is established within an agency other than the office of the mayor, by the head of such agency
5958278.agency: the mayor or, if the office is established within an agency other than the office of the mayor, by the head of such agency
5958278.agency_full: the mayor or, if the office is established within an agency other than the office of the mayor, by the head of such agency
5958278.action_summary: Appoint a director of healthcare accountability to head the office.
5958278.quote: Such office shall be headed by a director of healthcare accountability, who shall be appointed by the mayor or, if the office is established within an agency other than the office of the mayor, by the head of such agency.

5958278.action_summary: Provide recommendations to the mayor, council, comptroller, or trustees of the city pension systems regarding healthcare and hospital costs, including safety net hospital needs and recommendations to the New York state commissioner of health.
5958278.quote: Provide recommendations to the mayor, council, comptroller, or trustees of the city pension systems regarding healthcare and hospital costs, including, but not limited to, the proportion of healthcare costs spent on hospital care. Such recommendations shall acknowledge and differentiate the needs of safety net hospitals and their reimbursements from Medicaid, and provide recommendations to the New York state commissioner of health to stabilize safety net hospitals

5958278.action_summary: Analyze city expenditures on healthcare costs for city employees, city retirees, and their dependents to the extent such information is publicly available.
5958278.quote: Analyze city expenditures on healthcare costs for city employees, city retirees, and their dependents to the extent such information is publicly available

5958278.action_summary: Provide on the office's website in a simplified and publicly accessible format information on the publicly available price of common hospital procedures, formatted to allow for price comparisons between hospitals.
5958278.quote: Provide on the office's website in a simplified and publicly accessible format, information on the publicly available price of common hospital procedures. Such information shall be based on any publicly available information relating to the price of hospital procedures, including disclosures required pursuant to state and federal law, and shall be formatted in a way to allow for price comparisons between hospitals for such common procedures

5958278.action_summary: Convene key stakeholders in healthcare, including representatives of hospitals, healthcare providers, health plans, and self-insured entities, to examine the costs of healthcare services in the city.
5958278.quote: Convene key stakeholders in healthcare, including, but not limited to, representatives of hospitals, healthcare providers, health plans, and self-insured entities, to examine the costs of healthcare services in the city

5958278.action_summary: Collect and make available upon request each hospital's United States internal revenue service form 990, Schedule H, audited financial statements, and annual cost reports as required by federal law and centers for medicare and medicaid services.
5958278.quote: Collect and make available, upon request, each hospital's United States internal revenue service form 990, Schedule H as required pursuant to section 501(r) of the internal revenue service code, audited financial statements as required pursuant to section 6033(b)(15)(b) of the internal revenue service code, and annual cost reports as required by centers for medicare and medicaid services.

5958278.action_summary: Submit to the mayor, the speaker of the council, and the attorney general of the state of New York, and post conspicuously on the office's website, an annual report detailing the pricing practices of hospital systems in the city.
5958278.quote: No later than 1 year after the effective date of the local law that added this section and by January 1 annually thereafter, the director shall submit to the mayor, the speaker of the council, and the attorney general of the state of New York, and shall post conspicuously on the office's website, a report detailing the pricing practices of hospital systems in the city.
5958278.deadline_text: No later than 1 year after the effective date of the local law that added this section and by January 1 annually thereafter

2460487.action_summary: Update public data sets on the single web portal within ten days when such data sets are updated on another city or city agency website, or within one day if automated updates occur.
2460487.quote: when such public data set is updated on such city or city agency website, such public data set shall also be updated on the single web portal within ten days in accordance with the technical standards published by the department pursuant to section 23-505; provided that if any such public data set receives automated updates on such city or city agency website, such public data set shall be updated on the single web portal within one day

2460487.quote: the agency that maintains such public data set shall report to the department the reasons why it cannot meet such update schedule and the date by which the agency expects that it will be able to meet such schedule, and such information shall be disclosed in the compliance plan prepared pursuant to section 23-506

7430310.actor_raw: the office of operations, or the office or agency designated by the mayor
7430310.action_summary: Conduct a biennial review of all city forms that collect demographic information about ancestry and languages spoken, and submit to the council a list of reviewed forms, those eligible for updating, and explanations for those not eligible.
7430310.quote: the office of operations, or the office or agency designated by the mayor, shall conduct a review of all forms issued by the agencies described in paragraph 1 of this subdivision and any other agencies so designated by the mayor that: collect demographic information addressing the questions contained on the survey form, are completed by persons seeking services and contain content or language in relation to collecting such information that is within the administering city agency's authority to edit or amend

3626338.action_summary: Submit to the speaker of the council and the board of correction a report of alleged incidents of sexual abuse, sexual harassment and interventions against visitors by staff that occurred during the preceding six month period for which an investigation lasted longer than 90 days.
3626338.quote: Within 90 days of July 1, 2019, and every six months thereafter, the department shall submit to the speaker of the council and the board of correction a report of alleged incidents of sexual abuse, sexual harassment and interventions against visitors by staff that occurred during the preceding six month period for which an investigation lasted longer than 90 days
3626338.deadline_text: Within 90 days of July 1, 2019, and every six months thereafter

3626338.action_summary: Report to the speaker of the council and the board of correction a report of investigations of sexual abuse, sexual harassment and intervention against visitors by staff that were concluded during the preceding six-month period.
3626338.quote: Within 90 days of July 1, 2019, and every six months thereafter, the department shall report to the speaker of the council and the board of correction a report of investigations of sexual abuse, sexual harassment and intervention against visitors by staff that were concluded during the preceding six-month period.
3626338.deadline_text: Within 90 days of July 1, 2019, and every six months thereafter

3626338.action_summary: Submit to the council and post on its website the aggregate information from subdivisions c and d in the aggregate, including the number and percentage of each data point, and maintain such reports on the website for at least ten years.
3626338.quote: Within 90 days of July 1, 2019, and every six months thereafter, the department shall submit to the council and post on its website the information required in subdivisions c and d of this section in the aggregate, including the number and percentage of each data point
3626338.deadline_text: Within 90 days of July 1, 2019, and every six months thereafter

3626338.action_summary: Implement annual training regarding the treatment of visitors for staff who interact regularly with visitors and issue reports on such trainings including descriptions of the training materials and the number of staff who have received the training.
3626338.quote: The department shall implement annual training regarding the treatment of visitors for staff who interact regularly with visitors. The department shall issue reports on such trainings, including descriptions of the training materials and the number of staff who have received the training.
3626338.deadline_text: within 30 days of January 1 of each year

3626338.action_summary: Ensure that all data collected pursuant to this section is securely retained, and retain such data indefinitely after the date of initial collection unless federal or state law requires otherwise.
3626338.quote: The department shall ensure that all data collected pursuant to this section is securely retained, and shall retain such data indefinitely after the date of initial collection unless federal or state law requires otherwise.

3626338.action_summary: Before making data collected pursuant to this section available to the speaker of the council, board of correction, and the public, remove an individual's name, all personal identifying information, and any other information the disclosure of which would violate any federal or state laws.
3626338.quote: Before making data collected pursuant to this section available to the speaker of the council, board of correction, and the public, the department shall remove an individual's name, all personal identifying information as defined by subdivision (a) of section 10-501, and any other information the disclosure of which would violate any federal or state laws.

6067581.quote: An agency or office designated by the mayor, in consultation with the department of parks and recreation and any city agency, state agency, public authority, or person whom the agency or office deems to have appropriate information or expertise, shall conduct a survey of property owned and controlled by the city of New York in each borough to analyze whether any such property may be suitable for the construction of a swimming pool

6067581.action_summary: Subject to appropriation, facility availability, and sufficient staffing, offer swimming lessons for children and adults.

6067581.quote: An agency or office designated by the mayor, in consultation with the department of parks and recreation and the department of education, shall develop a report concerning the feasibility of providing public access to suitable swimming pool facilities located in property under the control of the department of education buildings when school is not in session or such facilities are not being used for a school-related purpose.

3840821.action_summary: Post on its website and submit to the speaker of the council and the public advocate a report on reopened public assistance cases for each quarterly reporting period.
3840821.quote: The department shall post on its website and submit to the speaker of the council and the public advocate a report on reopened cases for the relevant reporting period.
3840821.deadline_text: The first such report shall be due on November 15, 2019, and shall cover the quarter that began on July 1, 2019. Subsequent reports shall be posted and submitted no later than 45 days after the end of each quarter thereafter.

3840821.action_summary: Store reports permanently and ensure they are accessible on the department's website, without containing personally identifiable information.
3840821.quote: The reports produced pursuant to subdivisions b, c and d of this section shall be stored permanently and shall be accessible on the department's website.

Such statements, in addition to information about the number and type of complaints regarding alleged violations of this subchapter received by the commissioner, shall be submitted to the task force by the commissioner on or before June 15 of every fifth year after 2018.

4313347.action_summary: Promulgate rules establishing the content of stormwater pollution prevention plans, consistent with the NYSDEC construction general permit.
4313347.quote: Set forth the content of SWPPPs, , including identifying those development projects requiring only erosion and sediment controls during construction and those development projects requiring erosion and sediment controls and post-construction stormwater management facilities.

4313347.action_summary: Promulgate rules establishing design standards for erosion and sediment controls and post-construction stormwater management facilities.
4313347.quote: Establish design standards for erosion and sediment controls and post-construction stormwater management facilities [, which shall not be less stringent than the standards set forth or incorporated by reference in the NYSDEC construction general permit].

4313347.action_summary: Promulgate rules establishing exemptions from permit requirements.

Promulgate rules providing for the regulation of development activity of less than one acre based on soil disturbance or impervious surface, where the department determines an appropriate reduction in threshold is necessary.
4313347.quote: [After completion of the lot size soil disturbance study required by the NYC MS4 permit, provide] Provide for the regulation of development activity of less than one acre, based either on total disturbance of soil or on amount of impervious surface created or replaced, where the department determines an appropriate reduction in the threshold is necessary [in accordance with the NYC MS4 permit] to carry out the purposes of this chapter.

4313347.action_summary: Promulgate rules establishing training, experience, and education requirements for qualified professionals and qualified inspectors.
4313347.quote: Establish training, experience and/or education requirements for qualified professionals and qualified inspectors [, which shall not be less stringent than those required by the NYSDEC construction general permit].

4313347.action_summary: Promulgate rules establishing procedures and fees for review of stormwater pollution prevention plans and issuance and renewal of permits.
4313347.quote: Establish procedures and fees for the review of SWPPPs and the issuance and renewal of permits required by this subchapter.

4313347.action_summary: Promulgate rules establishing record keeping, inspection, and reporting requirements for applicants and permittees to monitor compliance.
4313347.quote: Establish record keeping, inspection and reporting requirements for applicants and permittees to monitor compliance with this subchapter and approved SWPPPs.

4313347.action_summary: Promulgate rules establishing requirements for compliance certifications by contractors to be included with stormwater pollution prevention plans.
4313347.quote: Establish requirements for compliance certifications by contractors to be included with SWPPPs.

4313347.action_summary: Promulgate rules establishing standards for maintenance, inspection, repair, and replacement of required erosion and sediment controls and post-construction stormwater management facilities.
4313347.quote: Establish standards for the maintenance, inspection, repair and replacement of required erosion and sediment controls and post-construction stormwater management facilities.

4313347.action_summary: Review stormwater pollution prevention plans within time periods specified in rules and issue stormwater construction permits or MS4 SWPPP acceptance forms as appropriate.
4313347.quote: The department or a qualified professional designated by the department shall review the SWPPP within time periods to be specified in the rules of the department.

4313347.action_summary: Issue stormwater construction permits to developers upon acceptance of stormwater pollution prevention plans and all requested documentation.
4313347.quote: If the department accepts the SWPPP and all other requested documentation, the department shall issue a stormwater construction permit to the developer and, for MS 4 projects subject to the NYSDEC construction general permit, shall issue an MS4 SWPPP acceptance form for filing with NYSDEC.

4313347.action_summary: Send notice to developers indicating specific deficiencies when rejecting a stormwater pollution prevention plan.
4313347.quote: If the department rejects the SWPPP the department shall send notice of such rejection to the developer indicating the specific deficiencies that caused the department to reject the SWPPP.

4313347.action_summary: Not issue a stormwater construction permit until execution and recording of a maintenance easement binding on all subsequent owners of real property served by post-construction stormwater management facilities, except where the corporation counsel determines such easement is unnecessary.
4313347.quote: the department shall not issue a stormwater construction permit for the project until the execution and recording of a maintenance easement, which shall be binding on all subsequent owners of the real property served by such post-construction stormwater management facility, except where the corporation counsel has determined that such a maintenance easement is not necessary due to the property's ownership or use by a public agency or instrumentality.

4313347.action_summary: Ensure easement provides for access to post-construction stormwater management facilities at reasonable times for periodic inspection by the department or qualified professionals to ensure facilities are maintained in good working condition.
4313347.quote: The easement shall provide for access to post-construction stormwater management facilities at reasonable times in accordance with law for periodic inspection by the department or qualified professionals authorized by the department to ensure that such facilities are maintained in good working condition to meet the applicable design standards.

4313347.action_summary: May suspend or revoke a stormwater construction permit after notice and an opportunity for a hearing when there is substantial non-compliance with the law, rules, permit, or approved stormwater pollution prevention plan.
4313347.quote: The department may suspend or revoke a stormwater construction permit, after notice and the opportunity for a hearing in accordance with the rules of the department, when the department or, in the case of an MS 4 project, NYSDEC finds that there is substantial non-compliance with this subchapter, the rules of the department, the NYSDEC construction general permit or the SWPPP, including any major change to erosion or sediment controls or any change in a post-construction stormwater management facility during construction that has or could have an effect on the discharge of pollutants, or when a permit was issued in error and conditions are such that a permit should not have been issued.

6045614.actor_raw: The New York City Police Department

6045614.quote: A report of the number of firearms, including ghost guns and firearms created using a three-dimensional printer, or any piece or part thereof, possessed in violation of law that have been seized, disaggregated by precinct and type of firearm.

6045614.actor_raw: The New York city police department
6045614.action_summary: Submit annually to the city council and post on its website a firearms discharge report.
6045614.quote: The New York city police department shall submit to the city council and post on its website on an annual basis a firearms discharge report

6045614.actor_raw: The New York city police department
6045614.action_summary: Provide information and data reports to the council and post on the department's website within 30 days of the end of the reporting period, in electronic format where applicable.

6045614.deadline_text: within 30 days of the end of the reporting period to which the reports correspond or for which the relevant data may be collected, whichever is later

6045614.actor_raw: The New York city police department

6045614.quote: The New York city police department shall submit to the speaker of the council, the governor, the temporary president of the state senate and the speaker of the state assembly and post on its website annually a report detailing the total number of criminal complaints and arrests

6045614.actor_raw: The New York city police department
6045614.action_summary: Maintain and transmit in electronic format to the department of records and information services criminal complaint and arrest statistics for transit-related offenses and make available on their website, updating on at least a monthly basis.
6045614.quote: Such statistics shall be tabulated on a monthly basis and on an annual basis and shall be maintained and transmitted in an electronic format to the department of records and information services, or its successor agency, and be made available to the public on or through the department of records and information services' website

6045614.actor_raw: The New York city police department
6045614.action_summary: Submit annually to the mayor and speaker of the council and post on its website a report on domestic violence initiatives, indicators, and factors including complaints, chronic offenders, and outreach efforts.
6045614.quote: Beginning June 1, 2019 and annually thereafter, the department shall submit to the mayor and speaker of the council and shall post on its website, an annual report regarding certain domestic violence initiatives, indicators, and factors in the city.

6045614.actor_raw: The New York City Police Department
6045614.action_summary: Provide to the speaker of the council each quarter all academy, in-service, roll-call and other specialized department training materials and amendments distributed to cadets, recruits, officers and employees.
6045614.quote: All academy, in-service, roll-call and other specialized department training materials and amendments thereto distributed to cadets, recruits, officers and other employees of the department, except where disclosure of such material would reveal non-routine investigative techniques or confidential information

6045614.actor_raw: The New York City Police Department
6045614.action_summary: Provide to the speaker of the council each quarter a report of civilianizable positions by job title and the number of such positions that were civilianized.
6045614.quote: A report of the number of positions that are civilianizable, including a listing of each such position by job title, and the number of such positions that were civilianized.
