5570462.quote: Such report shall be posted on the website of the 311 customer service center and shall include (i) the date when each such request for service or complaint type was added to or updated on the 311 customer service center, website and mobile device platforms and (ii) an explanation of any obstacles experienced
5570462.deadline_text: No later than February 1, 2024, and every February 1 thereafter

5570462.actor_raw: the director of the 311 customer service center
5570462.action_summary: Make publicly available a dataset on public correspondence requesting additions of or updates to 311 request for service or complaint types, updated semiannually beginning February 1, 2024, including submission date, subject, recipient agency or office, and implementation status.
5570462.quote: Beginning February 1, 2024, the director of the 311 customer service center shall make publicly available a dataset on the submission of correspondence by the public requesting the addition of, or an update to, a request for service or complaint type. Such dataset shall be available on the city's website, updated semiannually

3860325.action_summary: Comply with court orders not to approve construction documents for or issue or renew permits for covered categories of work at covered properties where commercial tenant harassment has been found.
3860325.quote: issue an order to the department of buildings directing such department not to approve construction documents for, or not to issue or renew permits for, covered categories of work in the covered property

6557505.action_summary: Take measures necessary for implementation of the law, including promulgation of rules governing increased civil penalties for parking structure violations.
6557505.quote: the commissioner of buildings shall take such measures as are necessary for the implementation of this local law, including the promulgation of rules, before such date.
6557505.deadline_text: before such date [180 days after enactment]

7480055.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
7480055.action_summary: Promulgate rules regarding the form and manner in which delivery services must provide advance notice of layoff to contracted delivery workers at least 120 days prior to deactivation based on bona fide economic reasons.
7480055.citation: Section 6 of the local law, NYC Admin. Code § 20-1532(d)
7480055.quote: a delivery service must provide, in a form and manner designated by the department, an advance notice of layoff to such contracted delivery worker at least 120 days prior to such deactivation.
7480055.deadline_text: prior to such date [the effective date, which is 1 year after enactment]

7480055.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
7480055.action_summary: Designate the form and manner in which delivery services must provide notice of deactivation to contracted delivery workers within 72 hours after deactivating them.
7480055.citation: Section 6 of the local law, NYC Admin. Code § 20-1532(e)
7480055.quote: a delivery service shall provide, in a form and manner designated by the department, a notice of deactivation to such contracted delivery worker which contains a written explanation of all the precise and detailed reasons for such deactivation
7480055.deadline_text: prior to such date [the effective date, which is 1 year after enactment]

7480055.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
7480055.action_summary: Designate the form and manner in which delivery services must provide written explanation to contracted delivery workers who petitioned for reinstatement but were not reinstated within 30 days.
7480055.citation: Section 6 of the local law, NYC Admin. Code § 20-1533(c)
7480055.quote: such delivery service shall provide a written explanation, in a form and manner designated by the department, to such contracted delivery worker of all the precise and detailed reasons for such prior deactivation.
7480055.deadline_text: prior to such date [the effective date, which is 1 year after enactment]

7480055.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
7480055.action_summary: Promulgate rules requiring delivery services to collect and produce anonymized, aggregated data necessary to prepare annual reports on deactivations and alleged violations of wrongful deactivation provisions.
7480055.citation: Section 6 of the local law, NYC Admin. Code § 20-1538(a)
7480055.quote: The department shall promulgate rules requiring that delivery services produce anonymized, aggregated data necessary to prepare such report.
7480055.deadline_text: prior to such date [the effective date, which is 1 year after enactment]

7480055.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
7480055.action_summary: Make available on the city's website no less than annually a report on deactivations and alleged violations of wrongful deactivation provisions during the preceding calendar year.
7480055.citation: Section 6 of the local law, NYC Admin. Code § 20-1538(a)
7480055.quote: No less than annually, the department shall make available on the city's website a report on deactivations and alleged violations of sections 20-1532 and 20-1533 during the preceding calendar year.

7480055.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
7480055.action_summary: Establish a program providing information and assistance to contracted delivery workers relating to the wrongful deactivation provisions, including assistance by phone and email and outreach and education.
7480055.citation: Section 6 of the local law, NYC Admin. Code § 20-1538(c)
7480055.quote: The department shall establish a program that provides information and assistance to contracted delivery worker relating to the provisions of this subchapter. Such program shall include assistance by a natural person by phone and email and outreach and education to the public relating to the provisions of this subchapter.

7480055.actor_raw: the commissioner of consumer and worker protection
7480055.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
7480055.action_summary: Take measures necessary for the implementation of this local law, including the promulgation of rules, prior to the effective date of one year after enactment.
7480055.quote: the commissioner of consumer and worker protection shall take such measures as are necessary for the implementation of this local law, including the promulgation of rules, prior to such date
7480055.deadline_text: prior to such date [the effective date, which is 1 year after enactment]

7480055.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
7480055.action_summary: Investigate complaints alleging violations of subchapter 3 (wrongful deactivation provisions) of chapter 15 of title 20, except that the department may investigate such complaints, meaning investigation is discretionary for subchapter 3 violations.
7480055.citation: Section 2 of the local law, amending NYC Admin. Code § 20-1507(b)(2)
7480055.quote: Upon receiving a complaint alleging a violation of subchapter 3, the department may investigate the complaint.

7480055.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
7480055.action_summary: Promulgate rules concerning the maintenance, retention, and provision by delivery services of data necessary to implement and enforce the wrongful deactivation provisions.
7480055.citation: Section 6 of the local law, NYC Admin. Code § 20-1538(b)(1)
7480055.quote: The department may promulgate rules concerning the maintenance, retention, and provision by a delivery service of data necessary to the implementation and enforcement of this subchapter, which may include a requirement that a delivery service adhere to a uniform system of records and submit such records and other reports as the department may determine, in accordance with applicable law and rules and with appropriate notice.
7480055.deadline_text: prior to such date [the effective date, which is 1 year after enactment]

7480055.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
7480055.action_summary: Promulgate rules establishing minimum requirements for progressive discipline policies maintained by delivery services.
7480055.citation: Section 6 of the local law, NYC Admin. Code § 20-1539(f)
7480055.quote: The department may promulgate rules establishing minimum requirements for the progressive discipline policy required pursuant to subdivision a of this section, including, but not limited to, requiring that a delivery service establish a system of graduated discipline based on the accrual of disciplinary points, strikes, or other similar consequences for misconduct or failure to satisfactorily perform job duties.
7480055.deadline_text: prior to such date [the effective date, which is 1 year after enactment]

7480055.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
7480055.action_summary: Designate the form and manner in which delivery services must provide deactivation notices to contracted delivery workers.
7480055.quote: in a form and manner designated by the department

1937607.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
1937607.action_summary: Make a new birth record when an applicant submits an application and supporting documentation requesting correction of sex designation.
1937607.quote: The department shall make a new birth record when an applicant submits an application and supporting documentation pursuant to this subdivision and subdivision b of this section requesting the correction of sex designation to the applicant's birth record.

1937607.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
1937607.action_summary: Provide or approve the form or manner for applications requesting correction of sex designation on birth records.
1937607.quote: Such application shall be made in a form or manner to be provided or approved by the department.
affected_groups: individuals seeking to amend sex designation on birth records

5641445.action_summary: Offer to screen incarcerated persons aged 18-21 without a high school diploma for dyslexia risk within 10 days of entering custody and refer those identified to evidence-based intervention programs.
5641445.quote: The department shall offer to screen all incarcerated persons between the ages of 18 and 21 who self-report that they do not have a high school diploma or its equivalent for being at risk of dyslexia within 10 days of entering custody of the department.

5641445.action_summary: Refer incarcerated persons identified through dyslexia screening as being at risk to evidence-based intervention programs.
5641445.quote: The department shall refer such incarcerated person who was identified through the screening as being at risk of dyslexia to a program that provides evidence-based interventions as necessary for persons who are at risk of dyslexia.
affected_groups: incarcerated individuals identified as at risk of dyslexia

5641445.action_summary: Offer to screen incarcerated individuals over age 21 with sentences and orders of commitment who lack a high school diploma for dyslexia risk within 10 days of receiving the order.
5641445.quote: No later than December 31, 2024, the department shall offer to screen all incarcerated individuals over the age of 21 who self-report that they do not have a high school diploma or its equivalent and who received a sentence of imprisonment and are subject to an order of commitment that provides that such incarcerated individual shall remain in the custody of the department.
affected_groups: incarcerated individuals over 21 with sentences and orders of commitment

5641445.action_summary: Offer to screen all incarcerated persons over age 21 without a high school diploma for dyslexia risk within 10 days of entering custody and refer those identified to evidence-based intervention programs.
5641445.quote: No later than December 31, 2025, the department shall offer to screen all incarcerated persons over the age of 21 who self-report that they do not have a high school diploma or its equivalent for dyslexia within 10 days of entering custody of the department.

5641445.action_summary: Submit quarterly reports to the mayor, speaker of the council, and public advocate and post on the department website regarding dyslexia screening and evidence-based intervention program referrals in city jails, including numbers screened and identified by demographics.
5641445.quote: No later than December 31, 2024 and quarterly thereafter, the commissioner shall submit to the mayor, the speaker of the council and the public advocate and post conspicuously on the department's website a report regarding dyslexia screening and referrals for enrollment in evidence-based intervention programs in city jails.
5641445.deadline_text: No later than December 31, 2024 and quarterly thereafter

5641445.action_summary: Coordinate with the office of criminal justice and city-contracted programs serving justice-involved individuals to identify and provide referrals to dyslexia screening and evidence-based interventions after release from custody.
5641445.quote: shall coordinate with the office of criminal justice and city-contracted programs that serve justice-involved individuals to identify and provide referrals to dyslexia screening programs and evidence-based interventions
affected_groups: justice-involved individuals released from DOC custody

3877906.action_summary: Provide out-of-court legal assistance at no cost to covered small business tenants regarding covered legal matters, and may provide in-court legal representation.
3877906.quote: Subject to appropriation, the commissioner shall provide, at no cost to a covered small business tenant, out-of-court legal assistance and may provide, at no cost to a covered small business tenant, in-court legal representation.

3877906.action_summary: Submit a biennial report to the mayor and speaker of the council on the operation of legal services provided, including data on served businesses and designated organization performance outcomes.
3877906.quote: On or before October 1, 2022, and on or before October 1 every two years thereafter, the commissioner shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council a report on the operation of the provision of legal services provided pursuant to subdivision b of this section during the previous two fiscal years.
3877906.deadline_text: On or before October 1, 2022, and on or before October 1 every two years thereafter

3877906.action_summary: Promulgate rules to implement the provision of in-court legal representation, including factors to be considered such as procedural posture, operational capacity, and compliance with applicable laws.
3877906.quote: To the extent the commissioner provides in-court legal representation pursuant to subdivision b of this section, the commissioner shall promulgate rules to implement the provision of such representation.

3877906.actor_raw: the department of small business services
3877906.action_summary: Offer assistance to covered small business tenants regarding federal, state, and city funding programs to alleviate the impact of COVID-19, including understanding eligibility, completing applications, and understanding terms of grants and loans.
3877906.quote: Subject to appropriation, the department of small business services shall offer assistance to covered small business tenants with respect to funding programs offered by the federal, state, and city government to businesses to alleviate the impact of COVID-19 on such tenants.

3963901.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
3963901.action_summary: Divide the geographic area of New York City into no less than twenty commercial waste zones.
3963901.quote: no later than 120 days after the effective date of the local law that added this section, the commissioner shall divide the geographic area of New York city into no less than twenty commercial waste zones
3963901.deadline_text: no later than 120 days after the effective date of the local law that added this section

3963901.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
3963901.action_summary: Issue one or more requests for proposals to conduct commercial waste removal in commercial waste zones and to collect containerized commercial waste citywide, and enter into agreements with awardees.
3963901.quote: No later than one year after the effective date of the local law that added this section, the department shall issue one or more requests for proposals to conduct commercial waste removal in a commercial waste zone and to collect containerized commercial waste citywide
3963901.deadline_text: No later than one year after the effective date of the local law that added this section

3963901.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
3963901.action_summary: Promulgate rules setting forth an implementation start date and final implementation date for each commercial waste zone.
3963901.quote: The commissioner shall promulgate rules setting forth an implementation start date and a final implementation date for each commercial waste zone established pursuant to section 16-1001

3963901.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
3963901.action_summary: Promulgate rules to establish fees to be collected from awardees for administration of the commercial waste zone program.
3963901.quote: The commissioner shall promulgate rules establishing fees to be collected from any awardee selected pursuant to section 16-1002 for the administration of the commercial waste zone program

3963901.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
3963901.action_summary: Maintain a list of displaced employees formerly employed by commercial waste collection businesses.
3963901.quote: The department shall maintain a list containing the names and contact addresses or telephone numbers of persons formerly employed by a business either currently engaged in the collection, removal or disposal of commercial waste

3963901.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
3963901.action_summary: Provide copies of the displaced employees list to applicants, licensees, awardees and designated carters upon request, and to awardees within six months of their agreement and every six months thereafter for five years.
3963901.quote: The department shall provide a copy of such list to an applicant or licensee pursuant to section 16-508 or an awardee or designated carter upon request. Additionally, the department shall provide a copy of such list to an awardee within six months of entering into an agreement with such awardee

3963901.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
3963901.action_summary: Establish an outreach and education program aimed at educating commercial establishments on the commercial waste zone collection system, including seminars, webinars, conferences and multilingual education.
3963901.quote: The commissioner, together with the chair of the business integrity commission and any other agency designated by the mayor, shall establish an outreach and education program aimed at educating commercial establishments on the implementation of the commercial waste zone collection system

3963901.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
3963901.action_summary: Distribute a multilingual letter to all commercial establishments within a commercial waste zone informing them of their obligations within 90 days following the selection of awardees.
3963901.quote: No later than 90 days following the selection of awardees within a commercial waste zone pursuant to section 16-1002, the commissioner shall distribute a multilingual letter to all commercial establishments within such zone
3963901.deadline_text: No later than 90 days following the selection of awardees within a commercial waste zone

3963901.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
3963901.action_summary: Conduct an outreach and education program aimed at educating businesses within the commercial waste industry about requirements and procedures for operating as awardees or designated carters.
3963901.quote: The commissioner, together with the chair of the business integrity commission and any other agency designated by the mayor, shall also conduct an outreach and education program aimed at educating businesses within the commercial waste industry about the requirements and procedures

3963901.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
3963901.action_summary: Issue an annual report to the speaker of the council and mayor, and post on the agency website, regarding implementation of the commercial waste zone program.
3963901.quote: On or before September 30, 2020, and annually thereafter, the commissioner shall issue a report to the speaker of the council and the mayor and post such report on the agency's website
3963901.deadline_text: On or before September 30, 2020, and annually thereafter

3963901.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
3963901.action_summary: Convene a commercial waste zone safety task force within 180 days to monitor industry conditions and make recommendations regarding worker safety training and public safety.
3963901.quote: No later than 180 days after the effective date of the local law that added this section, the commissioner shall convene a commercial waste zone safety task force to monitor industry conditions in order to make recommendations regarding improving worker safety training
3963901.deadline_text: No later than 180 days after the effective date of the local law that added this section

3963901.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
3963901.action_summary: Ensure that the commercial waste zone safety task force meets at least quarterly for the first two years and at least annually for three years thereafter.
3963901.quote: Such task force shall meet at least quarterly each year for the first two years of its existence and at least annually for three years thereafter

3963901.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
3963901.action_summary: Inform the New York state attorney general, state department of labor, U.S. Department of Labor or other relevant agencies when the commissioner has reasonable cause to believe a designated carter has engaged in egregious wage violations or significant labor law violations.
3963901.quote: Where the commissioner has reasonable cause to believe that a designated carter has engaged in or is engaging in actions: (i) involving egregious or habitual nonpayment or underpayment of wages, or (ii) that constitute a significant violation of city, state or federal labor or employment law, the commissioner shall inform the New York state attorney general

3963901.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
3963901.action_summary: Regulate the conduct of businesses authorized to collect commercial waste in commercial waste zones, including establishing and enforcing environmental, safety, health, service and operational standards.
3963901.citation: Section 753(e)(2) of the New York City Charter
3963901.quote: the commissioner shall have the power and duty to regulate the conduct of businesses authorized to collect commercial waste in commercial waste zones pursuant to title 16-B of the administrative code and any other applicable law, including but not limited to, the power and duty to establish and enforce

3963901.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
3963901.action_summary: Establish programs for education of the public and commercial establishments regarding the commercial waste zone system.
3963901.citation: Section 753(e)(3) of the New York City Charter
3963901.quote: The commissioner shall have the power and duty to establish programs for the education of the public and commercial establishments regarding the commercial waste zone system established pursuant to title 16-B of the administrative code

3963901.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
3963901.action_summary: Issue notices of violation for violations of commercial waste zone provisions and rules.
3963901.quote: Notices of violation for violations of any provision of this chapter or any rule promulgated hereunder may be issued by the department or the business integrity commission

3963901.agency_full: New York City Department of Sanitation
3963901.action_summary: Establish rules regarding impoundment and release of vehicles used in violation of commercial waste zone provisions, including amounts and rates of removal charges and storage fees.
3963901.quote: The commissioner shall have the power to establish rules concerning the impoundment and release of vehicles and the payment of removal charges and storage fees for such vehicles, including the amounts and rates thereof

6229020.action_summary: Develop informational materials about menstrual products (menstrual cups, tampons, and pads) for students in grades 4 through 12, including descriptions, usage instructions, health information, and information about free access in schools.
6229020.quote: the department, in collaboration with the commission on gender equity, shall develop informational materials about menstrual products to be shared with every student in grades 4 through 12
6229020.deadline_text: No later than 270 days after the effective date of the local law that added this section

6229020.action_summary: Post the informational materials about menstrual products on its website and update such materials as necessary.
6229020.quote: The department shall post the informational materials required by subdivision b of this section on its website and update such materials as necessary.

6229020.action_summary: Submit annually to the mayor and speaker of the council and post on its website a report on the distribution of menstrual product informational materials to school buildings, including school names, IDs, student counts, and whether materials were provided with or without request.
6229020.quote: the department shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council and post on its website a report on the department's distribution of informational materials required by subdivision b of this section
6229020.deadline_text: No later than 1 year after the effective date of the local law that added this section, and annually thereafter

3343776.actor_raw: an agency designated by the mayor
3343776.action_summary: Certify to the speaker of the council and the mayor that all buildings owned or leased by the city comply with sections 403.2.1 and 403.4 of the New York city plumbing code.
3343776.quote: an agency designated by the mayor, shall certify to the speaker of the council and the mayor that all buildings owned or leased by the city comply with sections 403.2.1 and 403.4 of the New York city plumbing code.

3343776.action_summary: Conduct outreach to the public regarding single-occupant toilet room requirements through educational materials in designated citywide languages, available on the commission's website, informing transgender and gender non-conforming individuals of building owner compliance obligations and violations.
3343776.quote: The commission on human rights, in conjunction with the department of buildings, shall conduct outreach to the public at large regarding single-occupant toilet room requirements, which shall, at a minimum, include educational materials to inform transgender and gender non-conforming individuals of a building owner's required compliance with sections 403.2.1 and 403.4 of the New York city plumbing code and the violations and penalties that result from non-compliance with such sections. Such materials shall be available in the designated citywide languages as defined in section 23-1101 and shall include a statement that any non-compliance with such sections may be reported to 311 and shall be posted on the commission's website.

3343776.action_summary: Conduct education and outreach to increase awareness of single-occupant toilet room requirements among business owners, including educational materials and sample signage in designated citywide languages, and make information available on the department's website.
3343776.quote: The department, in conjunction with (i) the mayor's office of immigrant affairs, (ii) the commission on human rights, (iii) the department of consumer affairs, (iv) the department of health and mental hygiene, (v) the department of small business services, (vi) the department of citywide administrative services and (vii) any other office or agency designated by the mayor, shall conduct education and outreach to increase awareness of sections 403.2.1 and 403.4 of the New York city plumbing code, regarding single-occupant toilet room requirements. Such education and outreach shall be tailored to business owners, and shall, at a minimum, include educational materials concerning such single-occupant toilet room requirements and the related posting and signage requirements, including samples of acceptable signage. Such materials and sample signage shall be available in the designated citywide languages as defined in section 23-1101. Information concerning such requirements shall also be made available on the department's website.

3343776.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and speaker of the council, and post on the department's website, an annual report on education and outreach conducted, complaints received, violations issued, penalties imposed, and subsequent inspections.
3343776.quote: By no later than April 1, 2019, and annually thereafter until April 1, 2023, the commissioner of buildings shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council, and post on the department's website, a report on: 1. The education and outreach conducted as required by section 28-103.32 including a description of how such outreach was conducted and the number of business owners reached through the outreach; 2. The number of complaints related to sections 403.2.1 and 403.4 of the New York city plumbing code reported to 311, disaggregated by online complaints and phone complaints; 3. The number of violations issued as a result of such complaints; 4. The total amount of penalties imposed as a result of such violations for the immediately preceding year; and 5. Whether subsequent inspections were conducted by the department to ensure future compliance with such sections of the New York city plumbing code.
3343776.deadline_text: By no later than April 1, 2019, and annually thereafter until April 1, 2023

6557285.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
6557285.action_summary: Post notice in affected areas indicating the effective date of permanent changes in parking restrictions.
6557285.quote: Following any permanent change in parking restrictions posted by the department, the department shall post notice, in the affected areas, indicating the effective date of such change.

6557285.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
6557285.action_summary: Reflect permanent changes in parking restrictions on the website containing parking restrictions within 1 business day of making the change.
6557285.quote: Within 1 business day of making a permanent change in parking restrictions, such change will be reflected on the website containing parking restrictions as required by section 19-175.1 of the code.
6557285.deadline_text: Within [one] 1 business day of making a permanent change in parking restrictions

6557285.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
6557285.action_summary: Notify by electronic mail the council member representing the geographic area at least 10 days before permanent full-time removal of any street parking space designated as a parking space, for bike share, or for a bicycle corral requested by a business within 2 years, stating the anticipated removal date, location, and intended new use.
6557285.quote: At least 10 days before the permanent full-time removal of any street parking space that will be used (i) as a designated parking space, as defined in subdivision a of section 19-175.5; (ii) for a bike share program, as defined in subdivision a of section 19-194; or (iii) for a bicycle corral for which a request was made by a business within 2 years of the date of the anticipated removal of such space, the department shall notify by electronic mail the council member representing the geographic area in which such parking space is located.
6557285.deadline_text: At least 10 days before the permanent full-time removal of any street parking space

6557285.agency_full: New York City Department of Transportation
6557285.action_summary: Post notice of temporary parking restriction changes as soon as practicable before conducting road repairs, stating the effective date and that no violations will be issued.
6557285.quote: Before the department makes temporary parking restriction changes to conduct road repairs, it shall post notice of the effective date of such restrictions as soon as practicable.

5698236.action_summary: Post on its website a quarterly report of consent search data collected from the preceding quarter, including total numbers of consent searches and denied consent requests disaggregated by race/ethnicity, gender, age, precinct, search type, and language access information.

3842658.agency: each district attorney office in New York City
3842658.agency_full: each district attorney office in New York City
3842658.action_summary: Post the annual report on the office's website in a format that permits automated processing and store all reports permanently and accessibly.
3842658.quote: Reports required pursuant to subdivision a of this section shall be stored permanently and accessible from each office's website, and shall be provided in a format that permits automated processing.
3842658.deadline_text: within 60 days of January 1 each year

3842658.agency: each district attorney office in New York City
3842658.agency_full: each district attorney office in New York City
3842658.action_summary: Provide written notice to the mayor and speaker of the council if unable to comply with any reporting provisions, describing the provisions of non-compliance, reasons therefor, and specific efforts to achieve future compliance.
3842658.quote: such office shall provide written notice of such inability to the mayor and speaker of the council within 60 days of the date the reports required pursuant to subdivision a of this section are required to be submitted

3022098.action_summary: Prohibit officers and employees from being subjected to the direction and supervision of the secretary of homeland security primarily in furtherance of immigration enforcement.

3022098.quote: No city resources, including, but not limited to, time spent by employees, officers, contractors, or subcontractors while on duty, or the use of city property, shall be utilized for immigration enforcement.

3022098.action_summary: Maintain a record of requests from non-local law enforcement agencies for city support or assistance intended to further immigration enforcement, including any response or actions taken in response.
3022098.quote: such officer or employee's agency shall make a record relating to such request, including any response or actions taken in response.

4805925.quote: On or before July 1, 2022, the commissioner shall report to the speaker of the council and the mayor about the program established pursuant to this section.

4805925.quote: If the commissioner finds that a permittee has violated this section or any rules promulgated pursuant thereto for the first time, the commissioner shall notify the permittee of such violation and request that action be taken to correct such violation in such a manner within 30 days and shall afford such permittee an opportunity to contest the commissioner's finding in a manner set forth in the rules of the department.

4805925.quote: In any proceeding before the environmental control board, no civil penalty shall be imposed for a lesser violation or for a first-time violation of the major violations listed in items 1.1 through 1.7 of this section if the respondent complies with the commissioner's order to correct and to certify correction of the violation within the applicable time period.

5570541.action_summary: Implement a protocol for identifying the language spoken by a caller, considering processes that do not require verbal requests for interpretation services.

5570541.quote: The 311 customer service center shall post on its website a description of such protocol within seven days after it is implemented.
5570541.deadline_text: within seven days after it is implemented

5570541.action_summary: Review calls with wait times of 300 seconds or longer to determine whether the wait time was due to a failure of the language identification protocol.
5570541.quote: If during a call to the 311 customer service center a caller makes a request for interpretation services and the wait time, as defined in subdivision a of section 23-308, experienced by such caller is 300 seconds or longer, the 311 customer service center shall review such call to determine whether the wait time was due to a failure of such protocol.

5570541.action_summary: Update the language identification protocol based on a review of calls where protocol failures were identified.
5570541.quote: No later than July 1, 2023, and every July 1 thereafter, the 311 customer service center shall update such protocol based on a review of all calls for which the 311 customer service center determined that there was such a failure of such protocol.
5570541.deadline_text: No later than July 1, 2023, and every July 1 thereafter

5570541.action_summary: Update the description of the protocol on its website within seven days after any update to the protocol.
5570541.quote: The 311 customer service center shall update the description of such protocol on its website within seven days after any update to such protocol.
5570541.deadline_text: within seven days after any update to such protocol

5570541.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and speaker of the council an annual report on the language identification protocol including implementation description, updates, and future plans.
5570541.quote: By July 1, 2023, and every July 1 thereafter, the 311 customer service center shall submit to the mayor and speaker of the council a report on such protocol that includes a description of the implementation of such protocol; any updates or changes to such protocol since the previous report, if applicable; and any plans to update such protocol in the future.
5570541.deadline_text: By July 1, 2023, and every July 1 thereafter

5534259.actor_raw: the commissioner of small business services
5534259.action_summary: Create an online portal with a mobile-friendly responsive design to assist with procedures and requirements to establish and operate a small business in the city.
5534259.quote: An online portal, created in coordination with the commissioner of information technology and telecommunications, to assist with procedures and requirements to establish and operate a small business in the city. Such portal shall have a mobile-friendly responsive design and shall facilitate the processes and procedures for establishing and operating a small business in the city.

5534259.actor_raw: the commissioner of small business services
5534259.action_summary: Make the portal accessible from the department's website in English and in each designated citywide language, and make available all city applications and related information including applications for permits and licenses needed to open and operate a small business.
5534259.quote: The portal required by this paragraph shall be accessible from the department's website in English and in each of the designated citywide languages as defined in section 23-1101. The portal shall make available all city applications and related information, including applications for permits and licenses, needed to open and operate a small business in the city, and provide for the submission of such applications directly from the portal.

5534259.actor_raw: the commissioner of small business services
5534259.action_summary: Enable a person to check the status of an application including for a permit or license issued by the city that was submitted by or is associated with such person's small business.
5534259.quote: The portal shall enable a person to check the status of an application, including for a permit or license issued by the city, that was submitted by such person or is associated with such person's small business.

5534259.actor_raw: the commissioner of small business services
5534259.action_summary: Allow a person to settle or pay outstanding balances on notices of violation through the portal or provide a prominent link to a website that provides such capability.
5534259.quote: The portal shall also allow a person to settle or pay outstanding balances on notices of violation, or include a prominent link to a website that provides such capability.

5534259.actor_raw: the commissioner of small business services
5534259.action_summary: Submit to the mayor and speaker of the council an annual report on updates to the portal implemented during the preceding calendar year, including the number of questions or complaints received and average response time.
5534259.quote: No later than February 1, 2025, and by no later than February 1 of each year thereafter, the commissioner shall submit to the mayor and the speaker of the council a report on any updates to the portal implemented during the preceding calendar year. Such report shall also include the number of questions or complaints the department received about the portal during the preceding calendar year, and the average time taken to respond to such questions or complaints
5534259.deadline_text: No later than February 1, 2025, and by no later than February 1 of each year thereafter

5534259.action_summary: Inform the Department of Small Business Services within 30 days of a change to a law or rule referenced in the guide or portal.
5534259.quote: Within 30 days after the effective date of a change to a law or rule referenced in the guide or portal described in subdivision a of this section, the agency having primary jurisdiction over such law or rule shall inform the department of such change.
5534259.deadline_text: Within 30 days after the effective date of a change to a law or rule

5534259.actor_raw: the department of small business services
5534259.action_summary: Update the guide within 30 days of being informed of changes to laws or rules referenced in the portal.
5534259.quote: Within 30 days of being informed of such change, the department shall update the guide accordingly.
5534259.deadline_text: Within 30 days of being informed of such change

5534259.actor_raw: the commissioner of small business services
5534259.action_summary: Review the effectiveness of the portal in facilitating assistance with respect to the establishment and operation of small businesses and implement any updates or modifications deemed necessary, including a survey of small businesses.
5534259.quote: No later than January 1, 2025, and no later than January 1 of every third year thereafter, the commissioner, in coordination with the commissioner of information technology and communications, shall review the effectiveness of the portal in facilitating assistance with respect to the establishment and operation of small businesses in the city, and implement any updates or modifications to the portal deemed necessary and appropriate. Such review shall include a survey of small businesses.
5534259.deadline_text: No later than January 1, 2025, and no later than January 1 of every third year thereafter

5534259.actor_raw: the commissioner of small business services
5534259.action_summary: Review the information, processes and procedures as necessary to create the portal and perform a review to ensure the portal includes all city applications and related information needed to open and operate a small business in the city before November 1, 2023.
5534259.quote: the commissioner of small business services, in consultation with the commissioners of consumer and worker protection, buildings, health and mental hygiene, sanitation, and environmental protection, the fire commissioner, and the head of any other agency that oversees requirements with respect to small businesses, as determined by such commissioner of small business services, shall review the information, processes and procedures as necessary to create such portal, and perform a review to ensure that such portal includes all city applications and related information, including applications for permits and licenses, needed to open and operate a small business in the city, in compliance with this local law before such date.

1890977.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection

1890977.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
1890977.action_summary: Impose civil penalties for violations of item pricing requirements, with authority to hold hearings upon due notice to determine whether violations have occurred.

3486135.agency_full: Fire Department of the City of New York
3486135.action_summary: Require installations of exit signs, emergency means of egress illumination, sprinkler systems, fire alarm systems, and alternative automatic fire extinguishing systems to be in accordance with the code.
3486135.quote: the fire commissioner shall require such installations to be in accordance with this code

3486135.agency_full: Fire Department of the City of New York
3486135.action_summary: Approve the installation, alteration or removal of alternative automatic fire extinguishing systems in accordance with section 105 of the New York city fire code.
3486135.quote: The installation, alteration or removal of alternative automatic fire extinguishing systems, including but not limited to fire extinguishing systems for commercial cooking equipment, subject to the approval of the fire department in accordance with section 105 of the New York city fire code.

3486135.agency_full: Fire Department of the City of New York
3486135.action_summary: Approve the installation, alteration or removal of fire alarm systems, emergency alarm systems and fire department in-building auxiliary radio communication systems in accordance with the requirements of the code, and require such work to be submitted in accordance with fire department rules and regulations.
3486135.quote: The installation, alteration or removal of fire alarm systems, emergency alarm systems and fire department in-building auxiliary radio communication systems, subject to the approval of the fire department in accordance with the requirements of this code. Such work shall be submitted in accordance with the rules and regulations of the fire department.

3486135.agency_full: Fire Department of the City of New York
3486135.action_summary: Review and approve fire protection plans for covered buildings for compliance with the code prior to issuance of a certificate of occupancy, temporary certificate of occupancy, or letter of completion.
3486135.quote: Such plan shall be submitted for review and approval by the fire department for compliance with this code prior to issuance of a certificate of occupancy, a temporary certificate of occupancy or a letter of completion, as applicable.

3486135.agency_full: Fire Department of the City of New York
3486135.action_summary: Establish rules and regulations regarding the submission of fire protection plans.
3486135.quote: The fire protection plan shall be submitted in accordance with the rules and regulations of the fire department.

3486135.agency_full: Fire Department of the City of New York
3486135.action_summary: File and review design and installation documents for alternative automatic fire-extinguishing systems for compliance with the code, the New York City Fire Code, and other applicable laws and regulations in accordance with Section 105 of the New York City Fire Code.
3486135.quote: Notwithstanding any other provision of this code, design and installation documents for the installation of alternative automatic fire-extinguishing systems shall be filed with and reviewed by the Fire Department for compliance with this code, the New York City Fire Code and other applicable laws and regulations in accordance with Section 105 of the New York City Fire Code.

3486135.agency_full: Fire Department of the City of New York
3486135.action_summary: Approve automatic fire-extinguishing systems installed as an alternative to required automatic sprinkler systems.
3486135.quote: Automatic fire-extinguishing systems installed as an alternative to the required automatic sprinkler systems of Section 903 shall be approved by the Fire Department.

3486135.agency_full: Fire Department of the City of New York
3486135.action_summary: Review and approve construction documents for fire alarm systems prior to system installation.
3486135.quote: Construction documents for fire alarm systems shall be submitted for review and approval to the Fire Department prior to system installation.

3486135.agency_full: Fire Department of the City of New York
3486135.action_summary: Review and approve amendments to approved fire alarm system construction documents before the final inspection of the work or equipment is completed, and establish rules regarding minor revisions that may be made and submitted after completion of work but prior to sign-off.
3486135.quote: Amendments to approved construction documents shall be submitted, and approved by the Fire Department before the final inspection of the work or equipment is completed, and such amendments when approved shall be deemed part of the original construction documents. The Fire Department may allow minor revisions of construction documents to be made and submitted to the Fire Department after the completion of work but prior to sign-off of the work in accordance with rules promulgated by the Fire Department regarding such amendments.

3486135.agency_full: Fire Department of the City of New York
3486135.action_summary: Review and approve construction documents for emergency alarm systems prior to system installation.
3486135.quote: Construction documents for emergency alarm systems shall be submitted for review and approval to the Fire Department prior to system installation.

3486135.agency_full: Fire Department of the City of New York
3486135.action_summary: Review and approve construction documents for ARCS (fire department in-building auxiliary radio communication systems) prior to system installation.
3486135.quote: Construction documents for ARCS shall be submitted for approval to the Fire Department prior to system installation.

3486135.agency_full: Fire Department of the City of New York
3486135.action_summary: Approve, deny, or preliminarily deny design and installation documents in accordance with procedures and time periods established for such review.
3486135.quote: the department shall approve, or deny, or preliminarily deny design and installation documents in accordance with the procedures and time periods set forth in FC105.2.4. Department approval of design and installation documents may be made subject to the requirements of the Building Code and other applicable laws, rules and regulations, and shall be documented and effective as set forth in this section.

3486135.agency_full: Fire Department of the City of New York
3486135.action_summary: Mark approval upon design and installation documents and/or issue a letter of approval or other form of written authorization upon review and approval.
3486135.quote: Upon approval of design and installation documents, the department shall mark such approval upon such documents and/or issue a letter of approval or other form of written authorization.

3486135.agency_full: Fire Department of the City of New York
3486135.action_summary: Approve the exemption of certain rooms or areas from automatic sprinkler requirements when they are protected with an approved automatic fire detection system and an alternative automatic fire-extinguishing system.
3486135.quote: When approved by the Fire Department, automatic sprinklers shall not be required in rooms or areas protected with an approved automatic fire detection system in accordance with Section 907.2 that will respond to visible or invisible particles of combustion, and an alternative automatic fire-extinguishing system in accordance with this code and the New York City Fire Code.

3498451.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
3498451.action_summary: By rule, define a lower blood lead reference level if the federal Centers for Disease Control and Prevention defines one lower than five micrograms per deciliter.
3498451.quote: the department shall (i) by rule define such lower level as the blood lead reference level for the purposes of this subchapter

3498451.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
3498451.action_summary: Submit a report to the mayor and speaker of the council detailing reasons why a lower blood lead reference level defined by the federal CDC should not be adopted or should result in alternative public health actions.
3498451.quote: submit a report to the mayor and the speaker of the council detailing the reasons why such lower blood lead reference level should not be adopted for the city or should result in alternative public health actions

3498451.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
3498451.action_summary: Promulgate a rule stating that the federal Department of Housing and Urban Development has provided performance characteristic sheets approving an x-ray fluorescence analyzer tested at 0.5 milligrams of lead per square centimeter, no less than 10 months after the effective date.
3498451.quote: no less than 10 months after the effective date of this section and upon the promulgation of a rule by the department stating that the federal department of housing and urban development has provided at least one performance characteristic sheet or other sufficient written technical guidance approving a commercially available x-ray fluorescence analyzer tested at the level of 0.5 milligrams of lead per square centimeter
3498451.deadline_text: no less than 10 months after the effective date of this section

3498451.action_summary: Define in the health code lower levels of lead-contaminated dust if the federal EPA or HUD adopts lower definitions.
3498451.quote: if the federal environmental protection agency or a successor agency, or the federal department of housing and urban development or a successor agency, adopts lower definitions of lead-contaminated dust, the board of health shall define in the health code such lower levels for the purposes of this subchapter

3498451.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
3498451.action_summary: Establish requirements for owners of previously exempted dwelling units to notify the department of turnover of the dwelling unit.
3498451.quote: The department shall establish requirements for the owner of a dwelling unit that has been granted an exemption by the department prior to the effective date of this subdivision to notify the department of the turnover of the dwelling unit.

3498451.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
3498451.action_summary: Within fifteen days of issuing a commissioner's order to abate lead-based paint or unsafe lead paint hazards, notify the owner of the multiple dwelling that the owner must provide all records required under the article within forty-five days.
3498451.quote: the department, within fifteen days of such order, shall notify the owner of the multiple dwelling where the dwelling unit is located that the owner shall, within forty-five days of the department's notice, provide to the department all records required to be maintained under this article
3498451.deadline_text: within fifteen days of such order

3498451.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
3498451.action_summary: Within ten days of receipt of records and determination that uncorrected lead-based paint hazards may exist in dwelling units with children, attempt to inspect such units for violations.
3498451.quote: the department within ten days shall attempt to inspect such units to determine whether there are any violations of section 27-2056.6 of this article

3498451.agency_full: Department of Housing Preservation and Development
3498451.action_summary: Establish safety standards for work to comply with notices of violation or orders to correct issued by the department for lead-based paint hazards or unsafe lead paint, no less stringent than those required by the commissioner's order to abate under health code section 173.13.
3498451.quote: which shall be no less stringent than the safety standards required by the commissioner of health and mental hygiene whenever such commissioner shall order the abatement of lead-based paint hazards or unsafe lead paint pursuant to section 173.13 of the health code or a successor rule. Such rules shall provide for temporary relocation provided by the owner of the occupants of a dwelling or dwelling unit to appropriate housing when work cannot be performed safely. Such rules shall provide that all such work be performed only by firms which have received certification to perform lead abatement under the regulations issued by the United States environmental protection agency

3498451.actor_raw: the department of health and mental hygiene
3498451.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
3498451.action_summary: Conduct investigation to identify potential sources of elevated blood lead level when a report is made of a person under eighteen with an elevated blood lead level at or above the blood lead reference level, including inspection of the dwelling unit.
3498451.quote: the department of health and mental hygiene shall conduct such investigation as may be necessary to identify potential sources of the elevated blood lead level, including but not limited to, an inspection of the dwelling unit where such person resides

3498451.actor_raw: the department of health and mental hygiene
3498451.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
3498451.action_summary: Notify the Department of Housing Preservation and Development of each dwelling unit in a dwelling for which the department has issued an order to correct a violation.
3498451.quote: the department of health and mental hygiene shall notify the department of each dwelling unit in a dwelling for which the department of health and mental hygiene has issued an order to correct a violation

3498451.actor_raw: the department of health and mental hygiene
3498451.agency_full: Department of Health and Mental Hygiene
3498451.action_summary: Certify conditions to the Department of Housing Preservation and Development within sixteen days of the report of elevated blood lead level when the owner fails to comply with an order to correct a violation.
3498451.quote: the department of health and mental hygiene shall certify such conditions to the department of housing preservation and development. The certification procedure shall be completed within sixteen days of the report of the elevated blood lead level
3498451.deadline_text: within sixteen days of the report of the elevated blood lead level

4908135.actor_raw: the director of citywide environmental purchasing

4908135.actor_raw: the director of citywide environmental purchasing
4908135.action_summary: Post the annual report required by subdivision f to the director's website.
4908135.quote: post to the director's website, an annual report detailing the city's progress in meeting the purposes of this chapter, as specified in subdivision a of this section, and the city's environmental purchasing standards

4908135.actor_raw: the director of citywide environmental purchasing
4908135.action_summary: Maintain a website that includes information about city environmentally preferable purchasing functions, annual reports, all rules and directives, and other relevant materials.
4908135.quote: maintain a website controlled by the director that includes information about city functions related to environmentally preferable purchasing, including the annual report required by subdivision f of this section, all rules, directives and guidance promulgated by the director pursuant to this section, and any other information or materials that the director determines would inform the public

4908135.actor_raw: a contracting agency
4908135.action_summary: Submit to the director a report summarizing the analysis upon which the agency relied to find that inclusion of environmental purchasing specifications would not be consistent with obtaining the highest quality product at the lowest possible price.

4908135.actor_raw: any agency
4908135.action_summary: Beginning 12 months after the effective date, refrain from purchasing or leasing desktop computers, desktop-derived servers, laptops, electronic notebooks, computer tablets, or similar products unless they meet applicable EPEAT standards or another similar standard selected by the director.

4908135.actor_raw: any agency
4908135.action_summary: Stop purchasing or leasing incandescent lamps, including halogen lamps.
4908135.quote: No lamp purchased or leased by any agency shall be an incandescent lamp, including but not limited to a halogen lamp

4908135.actor_raw: the director of citywide environmental purchasing
4908135.action_summary: Promulgate rules setting maximum hazardous substance levels in new covered electronic devices purchased or leased by any agency, considering EU Directive 2002/95/EC and subsequent directives and other relevant governmental standards.
4908135.quote: No new covered electronic device purchased or leased by any agency shall contain any hazardous substance in any amount exceeding that proscribed by the director through rulemaking.

4908135.actor_raw: the city
4908135.action_summary: By January 1, 2008, develop a plan for the reuse or recycling of any covered electronic device purchased or leased by any agency.
4908135.quote: By January 1, 2008, unless otherwise directed by a subsequent local law, the city shall develop a plan for the reuse or recycling of any covered electronic device purchased or leased by any agency.

4908135.actor_raw: the director of citywide environmental purchasing
4908135.action_summary: Post the electronic device reuse or recycling plan and any updates thereto on the director's website.
4908135.quote: The director shall post such plan and any updates thereto on the director's website.

4908135.actor_raw: the city
4908135.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
4908135.action_summary: Beginning June 1, 2009, purchase and use green cleaning products to the maximum extent practicable, as determined by the director through testing and evaluation.
4908135.quote: Beginning June 1, 2009, the city shall purchase and use green cleaning products to the maximum extent practicable, as determined by the director.

4908135.actor_raw: the director of citywide environmental purchasing
4908135.action_summary: Publish on the director's website a non-exhaustive list of categories of green cleaning products that may be purchased by the city.
4908135.quote: The director shall publish on the director's website a non-exhaustive list of categories of green cleaning products that may be purchased by the city to comply with this section.

4908135.actor_raw: the director of citywide environmental purchasing

4908135.actor_raw: the director of citywide environmental purchasing

4908135.quote: The director, after consultation with the mayor's office of long term planning and sustainability and other agencies as appropriate, shall establish packaging reduction guidelines for contracts entered into by city agencies for the purchase of goods.

4908135.actor_raw: the director of citywide environmental purchasing
4908135.action_summary: Review packaging reduction guidelines and make appropriate revisions in accordance with subdivision b of section 6-304.
4908135.quote: The director shall review such guidelines and make appropriate revisions, if any, in accordance with subdivision b of section 6-304.

4908135.actor_raw: the director of citywide environmental purchasing
4908135.action_summary: Make packaging reduction guidelines available to all city agencies and publish such guidelines on the director's website.
4908135.quote: The director shall make such guidelines available to all city agencies and publish such guidelines on the director's website.

4908135.actor_raw: the city
4908135.agency_full: Not specified in the law text
4908135.action_summary: Purchase furniture for use in city facilities in accordance with rules promulgated by the director that further the environmental purchasing objectives set forth in subdivision a of section 6-304.
4908135.quote: Where the city purchases furniture for use in city facilities, the city shall purchase furniture in accordance with rules promulgated by the director that further the objectives set forth in subdivision a of section 6-304.

4908135.actor_raw: the director of citywide environmental purchasing
4908135.action_summary: Promulgate rules setting forth specifications for furniture to meet environmental purchasing requirements, considering standards and ecolabels recommended by the EPA and other applicable standards from government agencies or environmental standards organizations.

4908135.actor_raw: the director of citywide environmental purchasing
4908135.action_summary: Review the furniture rules and revise them as needed in accordance with subdivision b of section 6-304.
4908135.quote: The director shall review the rules required by this section and shall revise them as needed in accordance with subdivision b of section 6-304.

4908135.actor_raw: the director of citywide environmental purchasing
4908135.action_summary: Take all necessary measures for the implementation of this local law, including the promulgation of rules, before the effective date.
4908135.quote: The director of citywide environmental purchasing, in collaboration with the commissioner of environmental protection and the director of the mayor's office of long term planning and sustainability, and in consultation with other agencies, as appropriate, shall take such measures as are necessary for the implementation of this local law, including the promulgation of rules, before such date.

4908135.actor_raw: each agency
4908135.action_summary: Submit an annual report to the director on compliance with environmental purchasing standards, including every exemption used for contracts registered in the prior year.
4908135.quote: submit an annual report as required by the director detailing such compliance, which report shall include all reports required for exemptions for contracts registered or otherwise made effective in the prior year

4908135.actor_raw: any agency

4908135.quote: power management software options of every computer, printer, facsimile machine, photocopy machine and other piece of office equipment that contains such software shall be calibrated to achieve the highest energy savings practicable

4908136.action_summary: Prepare a report documenting agency purchases of textile goods for the 4-year period preceding the effective date, including categorized textile goods, sample analyses, contract values, volumes, and authorized uniform vendors.
4908136.quote: The director shall prepare a report of the following information regarding agency purchases of textile goods for the 4-year period preceding the effective date of this local law

4908136.action_summary: Publish the textile goods purchasing report on the city's website.
4908136.quote: The director shall submit the report prepared pursuant to subdivision a of this section to the speaker of the council and publish it on the city's website no later than 180 days after the effective date of this local law.

4908136.agency: Task force on environmentally preferable purchasing, use and disposal of textiles
4908136.agency_full: Task force on environmentally preferable purchasing, use and disposal of textiles

4908136.agency_full: Task force on environmentally preferable purchasing, use and disposal of textiles
