4908136.deadline_text: No later than 1 year after the first meeting of the task force or publication of the report required in section one of this local law, whichever occurs later

4908136.agency: Task force on environmentally preferable purchasing, use and disposal of textiles
4908136.agency_full: Task force on environmentally preferable purchasing, use and disposal of textiles
4908136.action_summary: Create and recommend guidelines for environmentally preferable purchasing of textiles based on findings and conclusions, which may be agency-specific and may include guidance for extending textile use, reducing environmental impact during use, and environmentally preferable disposal methods.
4908136.quote: The task force shall recommend guidelines for environmentally preferable purchasing of textiles based on the task force's findings and conclusions made pursuant to paragraphs 1 and 2 of this subdivision.
4908136.deadline_text: No later than 1 year after the first meeting of the task force or publication of the report required in section one of this local law, whichever occurs later

4908136.agency: Task force on environmentally preferable purchasing, use and disposal of textiles
4908136.agency_full: Task force on environmentally preferable purchasing, use and disposal of textiles
4908136.action_summary: Submit a final report to the mayor and speaker of the council setting forth the task force's findings, conclusions, guidelines for environmentally preferable purchasing of textiles, and recommendations for legislation or policy, including recommendations for city management of agency-purchased textile waste.
4908136.quote: No later than 1 year after the first meeting of the task force or publication of the report required in section one of this local law, whichever occurs later, the task force shall submit a report to the mayor and the speaker of the council setting forth in detail the task force's findings and conclusions, and any supporting methodology and analysis, that form the basis of the task force's guidelines for environmentally preferable purchasing of textiles.
4908136.deadline_text: No later than 1 year after the first meeting of the task force or publication of the report required in section one of this local law, whichever occurs later

4908136.action_summary: Publish the task force's final report on the city's website no later than 5 days after its submission to the mayor and the speaker of the council.
4908136.quote: The director shall publish the task force's report on the city's website no later than 5 days after its submission to the mayor and the speaker of the council.
4908136.deadline_text: no later than 5 days after its submission to the mayor and the speaker of the council

4908136.action_summary: Appoint three persons with demonstrated expertise relevant to the task force's duties, who are not government employees, not in the business of producing or processing textiles, and not representatives of textile trade groups.
4908136.quote: Five persons, three of whom shall be appointed by the mayor and two of whom shall be appointed by the speaker of the council, who shall meet the following criteria
4908136.deadline_text: no later than 180 days after the effective date of this local law

4908136.action_summary: Appoint two persons with demonstrated expertise relevant to the task force's duties, who are not government employees, not in the business of producing or processing textiles, and not representatives of textile trade groups.
4908136.quote: Five persons, three of whom shall be appointed by the mayor and two of whom shall be appointed by the speaker of the council, who shall meet the following criteria
4908136.deadline_text: no later than 180 days after the effective date of this local law

4908136.action_summary: Convene the first meeting of the task force no later than 15 days after the last member has been appointed, or no later than 10 days after appointment of a quorum if not all members have been appointed within the prescribed timeframe.
4908136.quote: The chair shall convene the first meeting of the task force no later than 15 days after the last member has been appointed, except that where not all members of the task force have been appointed within the time specified in subdivision c, the chair shall convene the first meeting of the task force no later than 10 days after the appointment of a quorum.
4908136.deadline_text: no later than 15 days after the last member has been appointed

4908136.actor_raw: each agency affected by this local law
4908136.action_summary: Provide appropriate assistance to support the work of the task force.
4908136.quote: Each agency affected by this local law shall provide appropriate assistance to support the work of the task force.

4908136.actor_raw: each agency that requires such agency's employees to wear a uniform
4908136.action_summary: Provide information regarding technical specifications for uniform apparel and accessories to assist task force members in fulfillment of their duties.
4908136.quote: Each agency that requires such agency's employees to wear a uniform shall provide information regarding the technical specifications for such agency's uniform apparel and accessories, as appropriate, to assist the members of the task force in fulfillment of the duties imposed by this local law.

4908136.action_summary: In collaboration with other relevant agencies, take necessary measures for implementation of this local law, including conducting a survey of uniformed agency employees, before the effective date.
4908136.quote: the director, in collaboration with other relevant agencies, shall take such measures as are necessary for the implementation of this local law, including the conducting of a survey of uniformed agency employees, before such date.
4908136.deadline_text: before such date (180 days after the local law becomes law)

5999933.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
5999933.action_summary: Make an investigation of applicant qualifications and merits of each application for a games of chance license with due expedition after filing.
5999933.quote: The department shall make an investigation of the qualifications of each applicant and the merits of each application, with due expedition after the filing of the application.

5999933.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
5999933.action_summary: Issue a license to conduct games of chance upon determination that all statutory and regulatory requirements are met.
5999933.quote: the department shall issue a license to the applicant for the conduct of games of chance upon payment of a license fee of twenty-five dollars for each license period.

5999933.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
5999933.action_summary: Issue a license to authorized games of chance lessors to lease premises for games of chance upon determination of public need and satisfaction of statutory requirements.
5999933.quote: it shall issue a license permitting the applicant to lease said premises for the conduct of such games to the authorized organization or organizations specified in the application during the period therein specified or such shorter period as such department shall determine, but not to exceed one year, upon payment of a license fee of fifty dollars.

5999933.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
5999933.action_summary: Exercise rigid control and close supervision over all licensed games of chance to ensure fair conduct in accordance with license, board rules, and statute.
5999933.quote: The department shall have and exercise rigid control and close supervision over all games of chance conducted under such license, to the end that the same are fairly conducted in accordance with the provisions of such license, the provisions of the rules and regulations promulgated by the board and the provisions of this subchapter

5999933.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
5999933.action_summary: Conduct on-site inspections during the conduct of all licensed games of chance.
5999933.quote: An agent of the department shall make an on-site inspection during the conduct of all games of chance licensed pursuant to this subchapter.

5999933.action_summary: Prescribe a schedule of compensation for bookkeeping or accounting services related to games of chance.
5999933.quote: bookkeeping or accounting services according to a schedule of compensation prescribed by the board

5999933.agency_full: Department of Consumer and Worker Protection
5999933.action_summary: Promulgate rules and regulations necessary for proper implementation and enforcement of the games of chance subchapter.
5999933.quote: The commissioner of the department may promulgate such rules and regulations as deemed necessary for the proper implementation and enforcement of this subchapter and which are not inconsistent with those rules and regulations promulgated by the board.

7927500.action_summary: Make workforce stabilization payments of up to $10,000 to each eligible school paraprofessional in four installments according to the specified payment schedule during the 2026-2027 school year. Due in four installments: January 1, March 1, June 1 and August 1, 2027.
7927500.quote: Workforce stabilization payments shall be paid to each eligible school paraprofessional in four installments on the following payment schedule: no later than January 1, 2027 for the payment period from September 1, 2026 through November 14, 2026; no later than March 1, 2027 for the payment period from November 15, 2026 through January 31, 2027; no later than June 1, 2027 for the payment period from February 1, 2027 through April 14, 2027; and no later than August 1, 2027 for the payment period from April 15, 2027 through June 30, 2027.
7927500.deadline_text: no later than August 1, 2027 for the payment period from April 15, 2027 through June 30, 2027

7927500.action_summary: Prorate workforce stabilization payments for eligible school paraprofessionals based on the number of days each paraprofessional was on payroll in each relevant payment period during the 2026-2027 school year.
7927500.quote: The workforce stabilization payments required pursuant to subdivision b of this section shall be prorated according to the number of days an eligible school paraprofessional was on payroll in the relevant payment period during the 2026-2027 school year.

7927500.action_summary: Notify the corporation counsel following execution of all relevant collective bargaining agreements that provide for an increase in total annual compensation for all eligible school paraprofessionals equal to or greater than the workforce stabilization payment amounts.
7927500.quote: Upon such execution of all relevant collective bargaining agreements, the mayor shall notify the corporation counsel for the purpose of effectuating section 7-111 of the administrative code of the city of New York.

7966352.action_summary: Develop and implement a protocol to conduct in-person and phone-based wellness checks during cold weather alerts, extreme heat warnings, or heat-related emergencies for older adults lacking adequate in-home resources and social supports.
7966352.quote: the commissioner, in collaboration with the commissioner of emergency management and other relevant agencies as determined by the commissioner, shall develop and implement a protocol to conduct in-person and phone-based wellness checks during a cold weather alert, extreme heat warning, or heat-related emergency

7966352.action_summary: Determine the frequency of wellness checks during weather emergencies and establish criteria for when a wellness check must be conducted in person rather than by phone.
7966352.quote: the department shall determine the frequency of such wellness checks during a cold weather alert, extreme heat warning, or heat-related emergency, and shall consider the resources available to the department and such relevant agencies in conducting such wellness checks

7966352.action_summary: Establish criteria for when a wellness check must be conducted in person, considering factors such as the number of phone contact attempts and the older adult's living conditions and ability to leave home unassisted.
7966352.quote: the commissioner shall establish criteria for when a wellness check must be conducted in person. In establishing such criteria, the commissioner shall consider factors such as the number of attempts at contacting an individual via phone and living conditions of such individual known to the department.

7966352.action_summary: Develop a set of questions to gauge older adult well-being, conduct wellness checks that include written determinations and residential assessments, and provide safety information during weather emergencies.
7966352.quote: A wellness check shall include a set of questions developed by the department to gauge an older adult's well-being, a written determination of the apparent well-being of such older adult, and a report on the conditions in such older adult's place of residence

7966352.action_summary: Submit a report to the council describing the wellness check protocol established under the law, including the criteria for in-person wellness checks, and submit updated reports whenever the protocol or criteria are changed.
7966352.quote: the commissioner shall submit to the council a report describing the protocol established pursuant to subdivision b of this section, including the criteria for when a wellness check must be conducted in person. The commissioner shall submit updated reports as necessary whenever such protocol or criteria are updated.

8042529.actor_raw: the mayor, or the head of an agency or office designated by the mayor
8042529.action_summary: Establish and operate a program to coordinate inspections and plan reviews required for prospective businesses to open, including for child care programs and food service establishments.
8042529.quote: shall establish and operate a program to coordinate, between and among any necessary agency, any inspection or plan review required for a prospective business to open and begin to operate, and to reduce the time needed for a prospective business to open

8042529.actor_raw: the mayor, or the head of such agency or office designated by the mayor
8042529.action_summary: Submit an annual report to the speaker of the council and post on the city website regarding the program's effectiveness, including data on average time to open eligible businesses.
8042529.quote: shall submit to the speaker of the council, and post on the city's website or the website of such agency or office designated pursuant to subdivision b of this section, a report on the effectiveness of the program required by this section
8042529.deadline_text: No later than December 31, 2027, and each year thereafter

8042529.actor_raw: the head of an agency or office designated by the mayor
8042529.action_summary: Submit the program's report to the mayor when a mayor-designated agency or office establishes the program.
8042529.quote: Where the head of an agency or office designated by the mayor establishes the program required by this section, such head shall submit such report to the mayor

2694009.action_summary: Submit to the city council proposed amendments to the energy conservation code every three years or following any revision of the New York State energy code that establishes more stringent requirements.
2694009.quote: The commissioner shall submit to the city council proposed amendments that he or she determines should be made to this code to bring it up to date with or exceed the latest edition of the energy conservation construction code of New York state.
2694009.deadline_text: no later than the end of the third year after the effective date of this section and every third year thereafter

2694009.action_summary: Submit proposed amendments to an advisory committee for review and comment prior to submitting them to the city council.
2694009.quote: Prior to such submission, such proposed amendments shall be submitted to an advisory committee established by the commissioner pursuant to section 28-1001.3.2 for review and comment.

2694009.action_summary: Promulgate rules governing air barrier testing for new buildings, including testing requirements and acceptance criteria.
2694009.quote: Rules governing air barrier testing promulgated by the department.

2694009.action_summary: Approve or disapprove materials, methods of construction, designs, or insulating systems not specifically prescribed in the code that meet intent and achieve equivalent or greater energy savings.
2694009.quote: provided that such material, method of construction, design or insulating system has been approved by the commissioner as (1) meeting the intent of this code, (2) achieving energy savings that are equivalent to or greater than would be achieved using prescribed materials, methods of construction, designs or insulating systems

2694009.action_summary: Examine construction documents to ascertain whether construction is in accordance with the New York City Energy Conservation Code and other pertinent laws.
2694009.quote: the department shall examine or cause to be examined the accompanying construction documents and shall ascertain by such examinations whether the construction indicated and described is in accordance with the requirements of this code and other pertinent laws, rules and regulations.

2694009.action_summary: Perform or cause inspections and issue certificates of compliance for heating equipment or appliances installed to replace existing equipment.
2694009.quote: The requirements of Section 104.1 shall not be read to prohibit the operation of any heating equipment or appliances installed to replace existing heating equipment or appliances serving an occupied portion of a structure provided that a request for inspection of such heating equipment or appliances has been filed with the department not more than 48 hours after such replacement work is completed, and before any portion of such equipment or appliances is concealed by any permanent portion of the structure.

2694009.action_summary: Require submittal of evaluation reports from manufacturers or approved agencies for prefabricated construction assemblies with concealed mechanical work prior to work permit issuance.
2694009.quote: Prior to the issuance of a work permit for a prefabricated construction assembly having concealed mechanical work, the department shall require the submittal of an evaluation report by the manufacturer or approved agency on each prefabricated construction assembly

2694009.action_summary: Review and approve test and inspection records for prefabricated construction assemblies or designate specific records to be filed.
2694009.quote: Required test and inspection records shall be made available to the commissioner at all times during the fabrication of the mechanical system and the erection of the building; or such records as the commissioner designates shall be filed.

2694009.action_summary: Determine conformance of prefabricated construction assemblies to the energy code based on evaluation reports and other data.
2694009.quote: other data as necessary for the commissioner to determine conformance to this code.

2694009.action_summary: Promulgate rules establishing procedures and requirements for submitting compliance materials to demonstrate compliance with the energy code.
2694009.quote: the following documentation, as further described in the rules of the department, shall be required in order to demonstrate compliance with this code.

2694009.action_summary: Promulgate rules regarding progress inspections and their scheduling during construction.
2694009.quote: Progress inspections shall be performed in accordance with the rules of the department.

2694009.action_summary: Promulgate rules regarding the commissioning of mechanical systems, including commissioning plans, testing procedures, and documentation requirements.
2694009.quote: reference to specific checklists or worksheets which are necessary or required by the department

2694009.action_summary: Promulgate rules governing the extension of time for submitting the final commissioning report for buildings 500,000 gross square feet or greater based on good cause.
Promulgate rules regarding the submission and approval of construction documents for energy code compliance, including timelines and procedures.
2694009.quote: Construction documents shall be prepared in accordance with the provisions of Chapter 1 of Title 28 of the Administrative Code, the New York City Construction Codes, including this code, and the rules of the department.

2694009.action_summary: Prescribe the format and requirements for energy analysis documentation to be submitted with construction drawing sets.
2694009.quote: in a format as prescribed in the rules of the department

2513731.agency_full: Department of Youth and Community Development
2513731.action_summary: Submit a yearly report to the speaker of the city council, posted on the department's and ACS' websites, documenting the number of sexually exploited youth in contact with the department or ACS, disaggregated by age, gender, and service provider, including services provided and data collection methods.
2513731.quote: Commencing on April 30, 2016 and annually thereafter, no later than every April 1, the commissioner, in consultation with the commissioner of the administration for children's services ("ACS") shall submit a yearly report to the speaker of the city council, and posted on the department's and ACS' websites, documenting the number of youth in contact with the department's runaway and homeless youth services or ACS who are referred as, self-report as, or who the department or ACS later determine to be sexually exploited children
2513731.deadline_text: Commencing on April 30, 2016 and annually thereafter, no later than every April 1

2513731.agency_full: Department of Youth and Community Development
2513731.action_summary: Determine and document in the annual report the number of sexually exploited children who received services from both the department and ACS, and include descriptions of services provided, beds designated, mental health and health services, and data collection methods.
2513731.quote: The department and ACS shall also determine and document in such report the number of such children identified as having received services from both the department and ACS. Such report shall also include a description of the services provided by the department and ACS to meet the needs of youth who are or have been sexually exploited children including, but not limited to the number of beds designated for such children and the types of mental health and health services provided to such children. Such report shall also include the department's and ACS's methods for collecting data regarding the number of sexually exploited children.
2513731.deadline_text: Commencing on April 30, 2016 and annually thereafter, no later than every April 1
